title: El Gestor Administrativo ante los objetivos del PAT y su cumplimiento (The administrative manager in relation to the objectives of the PAT and its fulfillment)
affiliations: Universidad Internacional San Isidro Labrador - UISIL

detail.title: El Gestor Administrativo ante los objetivos del PAT y su cumplimiento (The administrative manager in relation to the objectives of the PAT and its fulfillment)

publicationDetails.detailsText: Universidad Internacional San Isidro Labrador Research Paper
publicationDetails.journalName: Universidad Internacional San Isidro Labrador Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This article explains administrative management from the perspective of its executor, in the complete development of their profession, and also how they address the fulfillment of the objectives of the Annual Work Plan (PAT), referring to managerial skills and competencies, but most importantly, to the correct handling and understanding of planning issues. On the other hand, the conceptual framework analyzes two key areas of absolute relevance: strategic planning and results-based management. This requires the alignment of clear goals that set a starting point and demonstrate strategic traceability for the development of objectives and their organization. The most important objective for an educational institution to grow and develop in any field, without encountering problems along the way, is to have good organization with the required governmental processes. Therefore, this article discusses the importance for the educational management figure to understand organizational behavior, thus helping to have better control over job performance by using different tools that allow them to advance and acquire new opportunities for their development. For an institution to achieve its established objectives, it must have a leadership figure that reflects the position they hold, through the application of concepts such as capacity analysis, priority selection, improvement plans, as well as risk identification and appropriate decision-making for control measures.

AI.tldr: 本文从执行者视角阐释教育行政管理，强调通过战略规划与结果导向管理相结合的方式，运用组织行为学工具提升管理能力，最终实现年度工作计划目标。
AI.research_question: 教育管理者如何通过战略规划与结果导向管理，运用组织行为学工具实现年度工作计划目标？
AI.motivation: 帮助教育管理者理解组织行为，提升工作绩效管控能力，推动教育机构可持续发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 战略规划理论、结果导向管理理论、组织行为学理论。
AI.method: 概念性分析/理论综述，基于管理实践的概念框架构建。
AI.findings: 教育管理者需掌握能力分析、优先级选择、改进计划、风险识别与决策控制等工具；领导力需通过战略可追溯性实现目标对齐；良好组织与政府流程是机构发展的基础。
AI.theory_contributions: 将战略规划与结果导向管理整合应用于教育管理领域，强调组织行为理解对管理效能的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育管理者提供了能力分析、优先级选择、改进计划、风险识别等实操工具，指导如何通过领导力实现机构目标。

title: Persistent Effects of Early Academic Rank on Cognitive and Noncognitive Outcomes
affiliations: Mississippi State University, University of Tennessee, Knoxville - College of Business Administration - Department of Economics and University of Florida

detail.title: Persistent Effects of Early Academic Rank on Cognitive and Noncognitive Outcomes
detail.abstract:
This paper estimates the effects of early academic rank in elementary school on later cognitive and noncognitive outcomes in the context of Mexico. We use linked administrative records to compare students with similar third-grade achievement but different ordinal positions. These rank differences arise from idiosyncratic variation in the achievement distributions of elementary-school cohorts. We find that a higher third-grade rank increases performance on a high-stakes high school admission exam. Both broader school-cohort rank and classroom rank contribute to this achievement gain when estimated jointly. Higher rank leads to more selective high school choices and improves self-reported measures of self-perception, academic aspirations, classroom responsibility, learning strategies, and teamwork attitudes by the end of ninth grade. We also provide evidence that higher elementary school rank improves students' high school placement outcomes.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文利用墨西哥行政数据，估计了小学三年级班级/年级内的学术排名对学生后期认知和非认知能力的影响。研究发现，更高的三年级排名能提升高中入学考试成绩、促进更优质的高中选择，并改善学生的自我认知、学业抱负、责任感和团队合作等非认知素质。
AI.research_question: 小学早期的学术排名如何影响学生后续的认知能力（如高中入学考试成绩）和非认知能力（如自我认知、学业抱负、学习策略、团队合作态度等）？
AI.motivation: 尽管学术排名是教育系统中普遍存在的现象，但其对长期发展的因果效应尚不明确。已有研究多关注发达国家，对发展中国家的证据不足。作者利用墨西哥独特的行政数据，旨在识别排名变化的因果效应，为教育政策（如分班、排名反馈）提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会比较理论（相对地位影响自我概念和动机）、人力资本理论（认知与非认知能力的互补性）、以及信号理论（排名作为能力信号影响升学选择）。
AI.method: 使用墨西哥联动的行政记录数据，将三年级学业成绩相似但班级/年级内排名不同的学生进行对比。排名差异来源于不同小学班级之间成绩分布的微小变化。同时估计了年级排名和班级排名的联合效应。
AI.findings: （1）更高的三年级排名显著提高了学生的高中入学考试成绩；（2）年级排名和班级排名对成绩提升均有独立贡献；（3）高排名促使学生选择更优质的高中；（4）高排名改善了九年级末的自我认知、学业抱负、课堂责任感、学习策略和团队合作态度；（5）高排名也改善了高中的最终录取结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在发展中国家的教育体系中，利用准实验方法分离出早期学术排名对长期认知与非认知能力的因果效应，验证了社会比较理论在基础教育阶段的适用性，并区分了年级排名与班级排名的不同作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育管理者提供了实证依据：小学阶段的排名反馈（如分班政策、成绩排名公布）会显著影响学生的长期发展；学校和家长应关注排名对学生自信心和抱负的塑造作用，尤其是对发展中国家的教育公平政策具有启示意义。

title: An Unfunded Mandate? Medicaid Continuous Coverage Requirements and State Fiscal Burdens During COVID-19
affiliations: University of California, San Diego (UCSD) - University of California, San Diego and University of California, San Diego (UCSD)

detail.title: An Unfunded Mandate? Medicaid Continuous Coverage Requirements and State Fiscal Burdens During COVID-19
detail.abstract:
At the COVID-19 pandemic's onset, the federal government enacted substantial changes impacting both the revenues and expenditures connected to states' Medicaid programs through a pair of provisions in the March 2020 Families First Coronavirus Response Act. These included a 6.2 percentage point increase in states' Federal Medical Assistance Percentages (FMAP), which raised states' revenues, contingent on adherence to a continuous coverage requirement. The latter provision raised expenditures by preventing the disenrollment of individuals whose eligibility would otherwise have lapsed due to changes in income or other eligibility-relevant circumstances. While these provisions were ex-ante expected to result in expenditures and costs of similar magnitudes, the ex-post realizations remain unquantified. Nationwide, we estimate that states’ share of the continuous coverage provision's costs was $139.2 billion, which is roughly $11.0 billion less than the revenues states received, in aggregate, through increased FMAPs. Revenues and costs varied substantially across states, however, with costs exceeding revenues by as much as $594 per capita, and revenues exceeding costs by as much as $838 per capita. The baseline parameters governing the federal government's share of states' Medicaid expenditures emerge as a key driver of the extent to which the continuous coverage requirement can be viewed as an unfunded federal mandate.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文量化分析了《家庭第一冠状病毒应对法案》中两项 Medicaid 条款对州政府财政的影响：6.2个百分点的联邦匹配率（FMAP）提升（增加收入）与持续覆盖要求（增加支出）。全美范围内，州政府承担的持续覆盖成本约1392亿美元，比通过FMAP增加的收入少约110亿美元；但各州差异显著，成本最高超出收入594美元/人，收入最高超出成本838美元/人。Medicaid基线匹配率是决定持续覆盖要求是否为"无资金联邦指令"的关键因素。
AI.research_question: 《家庭第一冠状病毒应对法案》中提高FMAP和持续覆盖要求两项条款，对各州Medicaid财政收入和支出的实际影响如何？各州之间是否存在显著差异？
AI.motivation: 虽然政策实施前预期两项条款的支出和成本规模相似，但事后的实际影响尚未被量化；且各州因基线FMAP不同，所受影响可能存在巨大差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 联邦与州政府之间的财政联邦主义理论，以及"无资金联邦指令"（unfunded federal mandate）概念——即联邦政府通过政策要求州政府承担额外支出而不提供相应资金补偿。
AI.method: 基于全国范围的Medicaid数据，对FMAP增加带来的收入增量与持续覆盖要求导致的额外支出进行定量估算与比较分析，并考察各州间的异质性。
AI.findings: (1) 全美层面，州政府持续覆盖成本约1392亿美元，比FMAP增加的收入少约110亿美元；(2) 各州差异显著，成本超出收入最高达594美元/人，收入超出成本最高达838美元/人；(3) 各州基线FMAP是决定持续覆盖要求是否为"无资金联邦指令"的关键因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 为"无资金联邦指令"理论提供了实证量化证据，揭示了联邦财政转移支付中基线匹配率对政策实际负担分配的关键调节作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者评估联邦卫生政策对各州财政的差异化影响提供了量化依据，有助于未来公共卫生危机中更公平地设计联邦—州财政分摊机制。

title: Residual Driving Force Minimization Enables Efficient Discovery of Single-Phase Alloy Regions
affiliations: Texas A&M University - Department of Materials Science and Engineering, Texas A&M University - Department of Materials Science and Engineering, Texas A&M University - Department of Materials Science and Engineering and Texas A&M University - Department of Materials Science and Engineering

detail.title: Residual Driving Force Minimization Enables Efficient Discovery of Single-Phase Alloy Regions
detail.abstract: Efficient identification of single-phase regions is a central challenge in computational alloy design because conventional phase-space exploration often requires brute-force sampling of high-dimensional composition domains. In this work, we propose a strategy for locating single-phase regions based on minimization of the residual driving force for competing phases, a thermodynamically meaningful metric that can be evaluated using CALPHAD models. To efficiently search this landscape, we employ Bayesian optimization with Gaussian process regression, which enables global minimization of expensive objective functions while reducing susceptibility to local minima. When derivative information is available, gradients of the residual driving force are incorporated using the Jansson derivative formulation introduced in Kunselman's work, enabling derivative-informed Gaussian processes that further improve sample efficiency. We demonstrate the approach on the Cr-Fe-Ni sigma phase search at 1200~K, where the derivative-informed workflow consistently locates single-phase compositions within 18 CALPHAD queries---substantially fewer than the approximately 3450 grid points in the admissible region---and outperforms both phase-fraction-based and random search baselines across 100 independent campaigns. The framework remains applicable with standard Gaussian processes when derivatives are unavailable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于残余驱动力的贝叶斯优化策略，用于高效定位合金中的单相区，在Cr-Fe-Ni sigma相搜索中，仅需18次CALPHAD查询即可找到单相成分，远少于传统网格搜索的约3450次。
AI.research_question: 如何在合金设计中高效识别单相区，以减少对高维成分空间暴力采样的大量计算成本？
AI.motivation: 传统合金设计中识别单相区需要在高维成分空间中进行暴力采样，计算成本极高，亟需更高效的策略来加速这一过程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 残余驱动力最小化（基于CALPHAD模型）、贝叶斯优化（高斯过程回归）、导数信息高斯过程（Jansson导数公式）。
AI.method: 以最小化竞争相残余驱动力为目标函数，采用贝叶斯优化（高斯过程回归）进行全局搜索；当导数可用时，使用导数信息高斯过程进一步提升采样效率。
AI.findings: 在Cr-Fe-Ni sigma相搜索中，导数信息工作流平均仅需18次CALPHAD查询即可定位单相区，远少于传统网格搜索的约3450次查询，且优于基于相分数和随机搜索的基线方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 将残余驱动力作为热力学指标与贝叶斯优化结合，提出了一种新颖的单相区搜索框架；引入导数信息高斯过程提升了优化效率。
AI.practical_contributions: 为合金设计提供了一种高效的计算工具，可显著减少CALPHAD查询次数，加速新材料发现；无需导数信息时仍可适用，具有广泛实用性。

title: Dust in the Wind: The Health Costs of Great Salt Lake Desiccation
affiliations: Texas A&M University,  and Arizona State University (ASU)

detail.title: Dust in the Wind: The Health Costs of Great Salt Lake Desiccation
detail.abstract:
Air pollution from natural sources is often subject to less regulatory oversight, but can still be caused by human activities. Understanding the role for policy requires quantifying the source's pollution contribution, for which there is currently no standard methodological approach. This paper uses the context of the shrinking Great Salt Lake in Utah to model air quality impacts of the highly erodible and growing area of exposed lakebed. Using four common identification strategies in the air pollution literature, and three alternative pollution measurement technologies, we find consistent evidence of meaningful pollution increases attributable to the shrinking lake in non-winter months. Estimates are relatively invariant to measurement technology but vary across identification strategies. Marginal annual costs range from $81 to $175 million per 100 km2 of exposed lakebed. Scaling to the area of total exposed lakebed, annual desiccation-related health cost estimates range from $1.1 billion to $2.3 billion. Given the direct relationship between human water use in the basin and exposed lakebed, these results provide evidence for the cost-effectiveness of policies aimed at reducing consumptive water use.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用大盐湖萎缩导致湖床裸露的案例，采用多种识别策略和测量技术，量化了自然源空气污染（风吹扬尘）对人类健康的经济成本，发现每年健康成本高达11亿至23亿美元，为减少人类用水的政策提供了成本效益依据。
AI.research_question: 自然源空气污染（如干涸湖床扬尘）对人类健康和经济造成多大影响？如何量化这种由人类活动间接引发的自然源污染？
AI.motivation: 自然源空气污染通常监管较少，但其可能由人类活动间接引发。目前缺乏标准方法来量化此类污染的贡献，这阻碍了相关政策的制定与评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 空气污染经济学、环境健康成本评估、政策成本效益分析
AI.method: 利用犹他州大盐湖萎缩的案例，结合四种常见的空气污染文献识别策略（如工具变量、固定效应等）和三种替代性污染测量技术，对裸露湖床导致的PM等污染物增加进行因果识别与成本估算。
AI.findings: 1. 大盐湖萎缩导致的裸露湖床在非冬季月份显著增加了空气污染；2. 不同测量技术下的估计结果相对稳定，但不同识别策略间存在差异；3. 每100平方公里裸露湖床的边际年健康成本为8100万至1.75亿美元；4. 按总裸露面积计算，年健康成本达11亿至23亿美元。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为量化自然源空气污染的经济成本提供了方法论框架；2. 展示了多种识别策略和测量技术在不同设定下的表现差异；3. 建立了人类用水行为、湖床裸露与健康成本之间的因果链条。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了减少犹他盆地消费性用水的成本效益证据；2. 为类似干旱地区（如咸海、加州欧文斯湖）的环境管理提供了参考；3. 揭示了自然源污染监管的潜在必要性，推动了政策关注边界的拓展。

title: Frontier Knowledge in College and Student Success
affiliations: Yale School of Management and

detail.title: Frontier Knowledge in College and Student Success
detail.abstract:
We study whether exposure to frontier knowledge in college affects student outcomes. Combining 459,415 syllabi from seven Texas public universities with 107 million publications and linked student records, we measure each course’s proximity to recent versus older research in its field. Exploiting syllabus updates unobserved at enrollment, we find that frontier exposure increases completion, GPA, graduate-school attendance, and earnings, and reduces time-to-degree. Completion, GPA, and progression gains are broad, while graduate-school and earnings returns are larger for students with stronger preparation and family resources. The evidence suggests two mechanisms: frontier content keeps students engaged, and sustained exposure builds labor-market skills.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析德克萨斯州七所公立大学的459,415份课程大纲，并结合1.07亿篇学术论文及学生记录数据，研究发现大学期间接触前沿知识能显著提升学生的学业表现和长期职业成果。
AI.research_question: 大学课程中接触前沿知识是否以及如何影响学生的学业成果（如毕业率、GPA）和长期发展（如研究生入学、收入）？
AI.motivation: 现有文献对高等教育课程内容（尤其是知识前沿性）如何影响学生 outcomes 的因果证据匮乏，亟需系统实证研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资本理论、信号理论、学生参与度理论
AI.method: 利用课程大纲更新作为自然实验（学生在入学时无法观察到后续课程内容变化），结合课程-论文引用网络度量每门课程与前沿研究及老研究的距离，使用固定效应模型进行因果推断。
AI.findings: （1）前沿知识暴露提高了毕业率、GPA、研究生入学率和收入，缩短了毕业时长；（2）学业完成、GPA和学业进展的改善具有普遍性；（3）研究生入学和收入回报对准备更充分、家庭资源更丰富的学生更大；（4）存在两种机制：前沿内容保持学生参与度，持续暴露积累劳动力市场技能。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次从因果角度量化了课程内容前沿性（而非传统的课程难度或专业性）对学生人力资本积累的影响，拓展了高等教育生产函数理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为大学课程设计提供实证依据：建议高校更新课程内容以反映领域前沿进展；为教育政策制定者优化课程质量评估提供新维度。

title: Geopolitical Fragmentation, Sovereign Debt, and Dollar Dominance
affiliations: University of Kentucky - Gatton College of Business and Economics, University of Florida - Department of Economics and University of Virginia - Darden School of Business

detail.title: Geopolitical Fragmentation, Sovereign Debt, and Dollar Dominance
detail.abstract:
Countries borrow in dollars because dollar debt markets are deep and liquid. This paper develops a theory of when that dominance becomes fragile because countries have inherited dollar liabilities but increasingly earn yuan-linked revenues. In the model, countries begin with dollar-denominated sovereign debt. Geopolitical fragmentation raises their yuan revenue share through two channels: higher trade barriers with dollar-linked markets shift exports toward yuan-linked markets, and higher costs of using dollars in that trade make yuan settlement more attractive. Governments then face a choice: repay dollar debt using revenues that are less dollar-linked, default, or restructure into yuan. The paper identifies a liquidity spillover from restructuring: dollar-to-yuan restructurings deepen yuan debt markets, lowering refinancing costs and encouraging additional restructurings. The model shows when fragmentation produces limited restructuring and when it triggers a self-reinforcing shift from dollar debt to yuan debt. A cascade requires the liquidity feedback from yuan restructuring to be stronger than the dispersion in countries’ yuan revenue exposure.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文构建理论模型，研究地缘政治碎片化如何通过提高贸易壁垒和美元使用成本，使拥有美元债务的国家转向人民币收入，进而引发从美元债务到人民币债务的自我强化式重组浪潮。
AI.research_question: 地缘政治碎片化如何影响拥有美元债务的主权国家从美元债务向人民币债务的转换？何时这种转换会形成自我强化的连锁反应？
AI.motivation: 美元债务市场虽然深度大、流动性强，但地缘政治碎片化可能使各国收入来源从美元关联市场转向人民币关联市场，导致原有美元债务偿付能力下降，从而引发国际货币体系的根本性转变。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主权债务重组理论、货币国际化理论、流动性溢出效应理论、网络外部性理论。
AI.method: 理论建模，分析地缘政治碎片化通过贸易壁垒和美元使用成本两条渠道影响各国人民币收入占比，进而影响主权债务重组决策。
AI.findings: 美元向人民币的债务重组会深化人民币债务市场，降低再融资成本并鼓励更多重组；当人民币重组的流动性反馈效应强于各国人民币收入暴露程度的差异时，碎片化会触发从美元债务向人民币债务的自我强化式连锁转移。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"债务重组流动性溢出"机制，解释了从一种主导货币向另一种货币的系统性转变如何通过市场深度自我强化；界定了碎片化导致有限重组与触发连锁反应的条件边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解地缘政治碎片化背景下国际货币体系演变提供了分析框架；对政策制定者评估美元主导地位的可持续性及人民币国际化前景具有重要参考价值。

detail.abstract: This study assesses the potential contributions of Uganda's competency-based curriculum (CBC) to household sustainability and economic growth in Manafwa District, where 75% of households depend on subsistence agriculture and only 42% complete secondary education. Employing a mixed-methods design with purposive sampling of 50 participants, including teachers, administrators, students, and church leaders, the research addresses three questions: CBC elements aligned with local economic needs, church-led capitalization of CBC-derived skills, and policy recommendations for income generation. Findings indicate that CBC's three competency domains, technical skills (financial literacy, agricultural techniques), character development (leadership, resilience), and meta-learning capacities (growth mindset), directly apply to Manafwa's agricultural economy. The Church of Uganda, operating 37% of district schools and reaching 65% of households, can leverage this network through agricultural innovation centers, entrepreneurship incubation programs, skills-based cooperatives, and integrated spiritual-economic development initiatives. Evidence from existing programs shows household income increases of 28% from church-led coffee processing initiatives and 80% startup profitability within six months through CBC-aligned mentorship. Prioritized policy recommendations include localized teacher capacity building emphasizing coffee value chain analysis, formal church-government partnership frameworks, competency assessment reform measuring practical economic applications, targeted resource allocation to female-headed households (38% of households), and church advocacy establishing a CBC Economic Impact Observatory. An 18-month pilot project in three parishes is proposed to document baseline indicators, implement CBC aligned skills development, provide enterprise mentorship, and measure quantifiable economic improvements. The research concludes that CBC offers substantial potential for household economic transformation when intentionally implemented with economic outcomes in mind, with the Church of Uganda strategically positioned as the catalyst for translating educational competencies into tangible household improvements.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估乌干达能力本位课程（CBC）对Manafwa地区家庭可持续性和经济增长的贡献，发现CBC的三大能力领域（技术技能、品格发展、元学习能力）可直接应用于当地农业经济。乌干达圣公会作为关键催化剂，通过农业创新中心、创业孵化等项目已实现家庭收入28%的增长。研究提出18个月试点项目及政策建议，旨在将教育能力转化为实际经济改善。
AI.research_question: 三重研究问题：（1）CBC的哪些要素与当地经济需求相契合？（2）教会如何利用CBC衍生的技能促进家庭经济？（3）促进收入生成的政策建议有哪些？
AI.motivation: Manafwa地区75%家庭依赖自给农业，仅42%完成中学教育，亟需评估教育改革（CBC）对家庭可持续性和经济增长的实际贡献。
AI.theoretical_framework: 能力本位教育理论、人力资本理论、社区经济发展理论、教会-社会网络理论。
AI.method: 混合研究方法：目的性抽样50名参与者（教师、管理者、学生、教会领袖）；定量数据（收入变化百分比、创业成功率）与定性分析相结合。
AI.findings: （1）CBC三大能力领域（技术技能、品格发展、元学习能力）适用于农业经济；（2）教会运营37%学校、覆盖65%家庭，可成为关键实施网络；（3）现有项目显示：教会主导的咖啡加工使家庭收入增长28%，CBC对齐的导师制下创业6个月盈利达80%。
AI.theory_contributions: 将能力本位教育理论从学校场景拓展到家庭经济转型领域，提出教育能力→经济产出的转化机制，构建"教会-学校-家庭"三维联动理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出五项优先政策建议（本地教师能力建设、教会-政府伙伴框架、能力评估改革、资源向女性户主家庭倾斜、设立CBC经济影响观测站），并设计了具体的18个月三教区试点方案。

title: The Growth and Performance of Artificial Intelligence in Asset Management
affiliations: University of Melbourne, University of Texas at Austin - McCombs School of Business and

detail.title: The Growth and Performance of Artificial Intelligence in Asset Management
detail.abstract:
We examine the growth and performance of AI-driven investing. Using investment advisers' regulatory disclosures, labor market data, and fund strategy descriptions, we document that AI-driven investing has grown steadily since the early 2010s and is concentrated among hedge funds. AI hedge funds outperformed non-AI hedge funds in the early years, but this outperformance declined over time, even among early adopters. Contrary to concerns about AI-driven strategy homogeneity, AI hedge funds exhibit lower return comovement than non-AI peers. Our findings highlight both the alpha-generating potential and the limitations of AI as a source of investment performance.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了AI驱动投资的增长和表现。利用投资顾问的监管披露、劳动力市场数据和基金策略描述，发现AI驱动投资自2010年代初以来稳步增长，主要集中在对冲基金。AI对冲基金早期表现优于非AI对冲基金，但超额收益随时间递减，即便是早期采用者也不例外。与对AI驱动策略同质化的担忧相反，AI对冲基金的回报协同性低于非AI同行。研究结果凸显了AI作为投资绩效来源既具有阿尔法生成潜力，也存在局限性。
AI.research_question: AI驱动投资的增长趋势如何？AI对冲基金的表现是否优于非AI对冲基金？AI驱动策略是否存在同质化问题？
AI.motivation: AI在金融投资中的应用日益广泛，但对其实际绩效和潜在风险（如策略同质化导致的市场脆弱性）缺乏系统性的实证研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 有效市场假说、技术采用与竞争消退理论、策略同质化与系统性风险理论
AI.method: 利用投资顾问监管披露数据、劳动力市场数据和基金策略描述文本，采用定量分析方法比较AI对冲基金与非AI对冲基金的绩效差异和回报协同性。
AI.findings: 1) AI驱动投资自2010年代初稳步增长，集中于对冲基金；2) AI对冲基金早期表现优于非AI，但超额收益随时间递减；3) AI对冲基金回报协同性更低，未出现策略同质化问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了技术采用初期优势与竞争导致超额收益消退的动态过程；修正了AI策略必然导致同质化的理论预期。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和监管机构提供了AI投资工具实际效能的实证评估，提示AI优势可能随时间递减，需审慎对待AI投资策略的长期表现。

title: Writing Code vs. Shipping Code: Productivity Effects Across Generations of AI Coding Tools
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Sloan School of Management, University of Pennsylvania,  and

detail.title: Writing Code vs. Shipping Code: Productivity Effects Across Generations of AI Coding Tools
detail.abstract:
How do the productivity effects of AI evolve across successive generations of tools, and to what extent do task-level gains ultimately translate into final output? We study these questions in the context of software development, using data on more than 100,000 GitHub developers combined with their AI usage telemetry. In a matched event study design, we find that autocomplete, interactive coding agents, and autonomous coding agents each significantly increase coding activity (“commits”), with respective cumulative effects of 40%, 140%, and 180%. These gains, however, attenuate sharply across the production hierarchy: the 180% cumulative effect falls to 50% for the number of projects, and to 30% for actual releases. This pattern is consistent with the weak-link hypothesis: the strong productivity gains from AI are attenuated by human bottlenecks in the production chain, with an estimated elasticity of substitution of 0.25 between AI and human effort, which indicates strong complementarities. We further confirm these results across four major app marketplaces, finding a moderate increase in the number of new apps but no increase in total usage. Large task-level AI productivity gains have therefore translated only partially into shipped and used software thus far.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了AI工具（自动补全、交互式编码代理、自主编码代理）对软件开发生产率的影响，发现任务层面虽有巨大提升（最高180%），但在生产链下游（项目数仅增50%，实际发布仅增30%）大幅衰减，符合"弱环节假说"，AI与人类劳动的替代弹性为0.25，呈强互补关系。
AI.research_question: AI生产率效应如何随着工具代际的演进变化？任务层面的增益在多大程度上最终转化为最终产出？
AI.motivation: 尽管AI生产率提升的案例广泛存在，但任务层面到整体产出的转化机制尚不明确，需要量化分析AI在生产链各环节的传导效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 弱环节假说（Weak-link hypothesis）：生产链中人类瓶颈会削弱上游AI增益的传导效果；替代弹性（Elasticity of substitution）分析AI与人类劳动的互补性。
AI.method: 匹配事件研究设计，基于10万+GitHub开发者的AI使用遥测数据，结合四大应用市场的数据验证。
AI.findings: 三代AI工具的累积效应分别为40%、140%、180%（提交数），但项目数仅增50%，实际发布仅增30%；替代弹性0.25，表明强互补关系；应用市场新应用数量温和增长，但总使用量无显著增加。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统量化了AI生产率效应在不同生产层级间的衰减规律，验证了弱环节假说在AI应用场景中的适用性，并提供了AI与人类劳动互补性的弹性估计。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了AI工具虽然能极大提升编码效率，但受制于生产链下游的人类瓶颈（如项目管理和发布环节），企业需关注生产链薄弱环节的协同优化，而非仅聚焦单一任务层面的AI部署。

title: Deadly Stigma
affiliations: Carnegie Mellon University - Department of Social & Decision Sciences

detail.title: Deadly Stigma
detail.abstract:
How harmful is stigma in the “real world”? Answers are elusive because stigma is difficult to measure in observational data, and isolating its effects requires exogenous variation in stigma without variation in the stigmatized trait. This study addresses these challenges by focusing on a widespread form of stigma — weight stigma — in the high-stakes setting of inpatient healthcare. BMI categories are displayed prominently to providers in electronic medical records, and obesity is heavily stigmatized socially. Thus, at the "obese" cutoff, stigma may shift discretely while the underlying trait (BMI) does not. Using a regression discontinuity design that exploits this institutional feature, I find a discontinuous increase in in-hospital mortality at this cutoff, though patient health does not change. Two patterns suggest stigma-based discrimination as the mechanism. First, just-obese patients receive less diagnostic effort than almost-obese patients. Second, a physician-validated LLM identifies at the cutoff a rise in stigmatizing language in clinical notes — specifically, language that imposes moral judgment, undermines patient credibility, and stereotypes patients — among the most stigmatizing providers, who also drive the mortality result. Overall, these results suggest that stigma is a powerful social force with potentially life-or-death consequences.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用电子病历中BMI类别在"肥胖"临界点的非连续性特征，采用断点回归设计，发现患者在肥胖临界点处的院内死亡率出现非连续上升，而患者健康状况并无变化。机制分析表明，污名化歧视——表现为诊断投入减少和临床笔记中污名化语言增加——是导致这一结果的主要原因。
AI.research_question: 污名（stigma）在现实世界中究竟有多大的伤害性？具体而言，体重污名（weight stigma）是否以及在多大程度上影响住院患者的医疗结局？
AI.motivation: 污名在观测数据中难以衡量，且将其效应与受污名特征本身分离开来需要外生变异，这一方法论挑战使得污名的真实影响长期难以被量化。本研究利用电子病历中BMI类别在"肥胖"临界点处的制度性特征，创新性地解决了这一识别困境。
AI.theoretical_framework: 污名理论：污名是一种社会力量，当个体因某一特征被社会贬低时，可能面临歧视性对待；断点回归设计（RDD）识别策略：利用BMI在"肥胖"临界点处类别标签不连续变化而潜在特质（BMI）连续变化的制度特征，识别污名的因果效应。
AI.method: 断点回归设计（Regression Discontinuity Design），利用电子病历中BMI类别在"肥胖"临界点（BMI=30）的制度性断点；辅以大型语言模型（LLM）对临床笔记进行污名化语言分析。
AI.findings: （1）在肥胖临界点处，院内死亡率出现非连续显著上升，而患者健康状况无变化；（2）刚达到"肥胖"标准的患者获得的诊断投入少于接近但未达"肥胖"标准的患者；（3）在肥胖临界点处，临床笔记中污名化语言（道德评判、削弱患者可信度、刻板印象）显著增加，且主要由污名化程度最高的医生驱动，而这些医生也驱动了死亡率结果的上升。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在高度现实的高风险环境（住院医疗）中，利用准实验方法（RDD）提供了污名因果效应的严谨证据，揭示了污名作为一种社会力量可能产生危及生命的严重后果。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了电子病历中的BMI分类标签可能通过触发医生的污名化态度和歧视性行为，对患者健康产生实质性负面影响（甚至增加死亡风险）。这一发现对医疗信息系统设计、临床决策支持系统的优化以及医务人员的偏见意识培训具有重要启示。

title: The AGI Race and Existential Risk
affiliations: University of Chicago - Harris School of Public Policy, University of Chicago and Vanderbilt University

detail.title: The AGI Race and Existential Risk
detail.abstract:
Concerns about the race to artificial general intelligence often assume that competition and resources increase risk by accelerating development. We study a model in which firms allocate scarce resources between speed and safety. Speed increases a firm's chance of reaching AGI first but leaves fewer resources for safety; safety lowers doom risk but slows arrival. Fragmentation increases total speed and conditional doom risk by shifting a fixed industry resource pool toward speed. The model also identifies a critical market size: below it, firms have positive expected payoff from achieving AGI, while above it, firms race even though achieving AGI has negative expected value. More per-firm resources always accelerate expected arrival, but their effect on conditional doom risk changes sign at this cutoff. Policy affects risk by changing equilibrium incentives: consolidation, resource regulation, commitment devices, and cautious public entry can improve welfare in some environments. The results show that AGI risk depends not only on technical considerations, but also on market structure, resource constraints, and institutions that shape the equilibrium allocation between speed and safety.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文通过博弈模型研究企业在速度与安全之间分配资源对AGI竞赛风险的影响，发现市场结构、资源约束和制度安排是决定AGI风险的关键因素。
AI.research_question: 竞争和资源如何影响企业在AGI研发中速度与安全的权衡，进而影响AGI带来的末日风险？
AI.motivation: 关于AGI竞赛的主流担忧往往假设竞争和资源增加会通过加速开发而提升风险，但忽视了企业在速度与安全之间的资源分配权衡。本文试图通过建模揭示市场结构与资源约束如何塑造这种权衡。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论、资源分配模型、市场结构理论
AI.method: 构建企业间资源分配博弈模型，分析企业在速度与安全之间权衡资源分配的策略均衡，并考察市场碎片化、企业数量、资源规模等参数变化的影响。
AI.findings: (1) 碎片化通过将固定行业资源池转向速度，增加了总速度和条件末日风险；(2) 存在一个关键市场规模阈值：低于该阈值时企业有正预期收益，高于时企业即使预期收益为负也会竞相投入；(3) 单个企业资源增加对条件末日风险的影响在该阈值处发生符号变化；(4) 合并、资源监管、承诺机制和谨慎的公共进入可在某些环境下改善福利。
AI.theory_contributions: 将市场结构、资源约束和制度因素纳入AGI风险分析框架，突破了过去仅关注技术因素的局限；揭示了竞争格局如何内生地决定安全投入水平。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了降低AGI风险的可行工具：行业整合、资源监管、承诺机制以及公共部门的审慎参与等，为AGI治理提供了经济学视角的政策建议。

title: Medicare Home Health Fraud: How Much, Where, and Who?
affiliations: Stanford University - Department of Economics, Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Department of Economics, Georgetown University, Stanford University and Stanford University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Medicare Home Health Fraud: How Much, Where, and Who?
detail.abstract:
How much fraud is there in Medicare and who commits it? We provide an answer for Medicare home health, a setting widely considered especially rife with fraud. We define a home health agency (HHA) as fraudulent if it was prosecuted by a federal strike force. Combining Medicare claims data on all HHAs with hand-collected prosecution records from the nine federal judicial districts where strike forces operated between 2009 and 2013, we train a machine learning model to predict, out of sample, the probability that each HHA in the remaining 85 districts would have been prosecuted had a strike force been present. We estimate that in 2008, 3.4% of Medicare home health spending — about $520 million — was billed by fraudulent HHAs. The strike forces were well-targeted: their nine districts contained only 40% of home health spending but 65% of fraudulent spending. Fraudulent HHAs display intuitive characteristics: they are more likely to rely on extremely high-volume referring physicians, to exhibit unusually uniform patterns of care, and to serve healthier-than-average patients.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文利用机器学习模型预测美国联邦医疗保健（Medicare）居家护理中的欺诈行为，估计2008年约3.4%的支出（5.2亿美元）来自欺诈机构，并发现联邦打击小组精准地覆盖了65%的欺诈支出。
AI.research_question: 美国Medicare居家护理中存在多少欺诈行为？谁在实施这些欺诈？
AI.motivation: 居家护理领域被广泛认为欺诈问题严重，但缺乏系统的量化估计；了解欺诈规模和特征有助于政策制定和资源有效配置。
AI.theoretical_framework: 欺诈检测理论、机器学习预测模型、行政数据与执法记录结合的分析框架。
AI.method: 利用2009-2013年9个联邦司法区的打击小组起诉记录作为标签，结合全美所有居家护理机构的Medicare索赔数据，训练机器学习模型，外推预测其余85个司法区机构的欺诈概率。
AI.findings: 1) 2008年约3.4%的居家护理支出（5.2亿美元）来自欺诈机构；2) 打击小组精准覆盖了40%的支出但捕捉了65%的欺诈支出；3) 欺诈机构特征包括：依赖超高产量的转诊医生、护理模式异常统一、服务对象比平均更健康。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种利用执法数据训练机器学习模型来量化欺诈规模的方法，为医疗欺诈的实证研究提供了新的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为Medicare反欺诈政策提供了量化依据，验证了联邦打击小组的精准有效性，并揭示了可用于识别欺诈机构的可操作特征。

title: Insurer Risk and Public Risk-Sharing: Quantifying the Value of Reinsurance
affiliations: Michigan State University and

detail.title: Insurer Risk and Public Risk-Sharing: Quantifying the Value of Reinsurance
detail.abstract:
We study the role of public risk-sharing in markets where firms face substantial cost uncertainty, focusing on public reinsurance in health insurance. We develop a model where insurers internalize cost uncertainty through risk charges that raise effective marginal costs, and create a role for reinsurance. Public reinsurance lowers both expected costs and cost volatility, particularly for smaller insurers, reducing prices and enhancing competition. Using an event study of staggered state-level reinsurance programs, we show that public reinsurance leads insurers to lower prices and private reinsurance purchases, benefiting financially constrained insurers the most. Structural estimates indicate that risk charges account for a substantial share of the premium-cost wedge, and highlight public reinsurance's comparative advantage over premium subsidies by providing risk protection and enhancing competition. Our results underscore the importance of accounting for firms' risk exposure in policy design and provide a general framework for understanding public risk-sharing policies.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究公共风险分担（公共再保险）在健康保险市场中的作用，发现其能降低保险公司的预期成本和成本波动性，尤其是对小保险公司帮助最大，从而降低保费、促进竞争。与保费补贴相比，公共再保险在风险保护和竞争促进方面更具优势。
AI.research_question: 在面临巨大成本不确定性的市场中，公共风险分担（特别是公共再保险）如何影响保险公司的定价行为、竞争格局以及私人再保险购买决策？
AI.motivation: 保险公司面临显著的成本不确定性，这种不确定性通过风险费用（risk charges）提高有效边际成本，进而推高保费、抑制竞争。公共再保险作为一种政策工具，其对市场的影响尚未被充分理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 保险公司将成本不确定性通过风险费用内部化，使得有效边际成本上升；公共再保险通过降低预期成本和成本波动性，特别是对小保险公司，来降低价格并增强竞争。
AI.method: 理论建模 + 事件研究法（利用各州交错实施再保险项目的准自然实验）+ 结构估计。
AI.findings: 公共再保险导致保险公司降低保费和减少私人再保险购买，对财务受限的保险公司帮助最大；风险费用在保费-成本差额中占很大比重；公共再保险在风险保护和竞争促进方面优于保费补贴。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个理解公共风险分担政策的一般性框架，强调了企业风险暴露在政策设计中的重要性，厘清了公共再保险与保费补贴在机制上的差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者设计公共再保险或类似风险分担政策提供了理论依据和实证证据，表明公共再保险能有效降低保费、促进竞争，尤其惠及小规模和财务受限的保险公司。

title: Optimal Long-Term Care Provision and Insurance with Heterogeneous Preferences and Risks
affiliations: HEC Montreal, HEC Montreal and HEC Montreal

detail.title: Optimal Long-Term Care Provision and Insurance with Heterogeneous Preferences and Risks
detail.abstract:
We develop a model of optimal long-term care provision and insurance with heterogeneous risk and preferences. Using a novel survey experiment, we estimate preferences (demand) for care settings and service bundles. We then calibrate health transitions and the supply of services using Canadian administrative data for the province of Quebec. The optimal insurance scheme has lower co-insurance in nursing homes and higher co-insurance in home care while leading to a constrained expansion of home care services. Relative to the prevailing system, optimal provision increases home care utilization, raises public expenditure threefold, and delivers a large increase in consumer surplus.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个考虑异质性风险与偏好的最优长期护理供给与保险模型，结合新颖的问卷调查和加拿大魁北克省行政数据，发现最优保险方案应降低养老院共同保险率、提高居家护理共同保险率，并约束性扩张居家护理服务，相比现行制度可大幅提升消费者剩余。
AI.research_question: 在异质性风险和偏好下，长期护理的最优保险方案和护理供给配置应如何设计？
AI.motivation: 现行长期护理保险和供给体系可能存在效率损失，需要基于个体异质性偏好和风险来优化保险设计和服务配置。
AI.theoretical_framework: 最优保险理论、异质性偏好与风险模型、长期护理需求与供给均衡分析。
AI.method: （1）新颖的调查研究：估计个体对护理环境和服务组合的偏好（需求）；（2）利用加拿大魁北克省行政数据校准健康状态转换和护理服务供给；（3）构建结构性模型进行最优保险方案求解。
AI.findings: （1）最优保险方案要求养老院的共同保险率更低、居家护理的共同保险率更高；（2）最优方案导致居家护理服务受到约束性扩张；（3）相比现行制度，居家护理利用率上升，公共支出增加三倍，消费者剩余大幅提升。
AI.theory_contributions: 将异质性风险和偏好纳入长期护理最优保险的理论分析框架，为保险与供给的联合优化提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者设计长期护理保险方案和护理资源配置提供了具体建议，特别是关于养老院与居家护理之间的保险共付率差异化设定。

title: AI for Structural Estimation
affiliations: University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign and University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign

detail.title: AI for Structural Estimation
detail.abstract:
We develop a global method to solve and estimate dynamic equilibrium models that treats prices as pseudo parameters and market clearing as moment conditions, and reduces estimation time from days to minutes. Our approach leverages AI algorithms, software, and hardware, and has three building blocks. First, we extend the state space to include equilibrium prices and model parameters, which allows us to clear markets and estimate parameters by solving the model once. Second, we approximate the mapping between parameters and moments by training neural networks on model-simulated data, which act as closed-form expressions for moment conditions. Third, we use this mapping to estimate parameters by minimizing the distance between the model and data moments, and to find equilibrium prices by targeting a market-clearing imbalance of zero. We also use this mapping to assess identification globally, verifying if the estimation objective function has a unique minimum for each parameter. We illustrate our method by estimating a dynamic general equilibrium model of leverage and investment with three state variables, three controls, endogenous default, costly equity issuance, and non-convex adjustment costs. After four days, the traditional approach does not reach the loss we achieve in under 20 minutes. We build an AI agent that applies our method to new models from natural language prompts.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种利用人工智能算法、软件和硬件来求解和估计动态均衡模型的全局方法，将估计时间从天级缩短到分钟级，并通过自然语言提示即可应用于新模型。
AI.research_question: 如何利用人工智能技术大幅加速动态均衡模型的求解与参数估计？
AI.motivation: 传统方法求解和估计动态均衡模型耗时极长（数天甚至更久），限制了模型的应用和迭代效率，亟需一种更高效的方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态均衡模型、伪参数方法、矩条件、神经网络近似映射、全局识别检验。
AI.method: （1）扩展状态空间，将均衡价格和模型参数纳入其中，实现一次性求解；（2）利用神经网络在模型模拟数据上训练，近似参数到矩的映射，作为矩条件的闭式表达式；（3）利用该映射进行参数估计（最小化模型矩与数据矩的距离）和均衡价格求解（以市场出清不平衡为零为目标），并进行全局识别评估。
AI.findings: 传统方法运行4天无法达到本文方法20分钟内实现的损失水平；该方法可显著提升效率，并可通过自然语言提示构建AI代理应用于新模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 将价格视为伪参数并纳入状态空间的创新视角；将神经网络用于矩条件近似，提供了全局识别检验的新工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 大幅降低动态均衡模型求解和估计的计算成本（从天级降至分钟级）；构建可基于自然语言提示自动应用该方法的AI代理，降低使用门槛。

title: Does the Import Invasion Explain the Mysterious Disappearance of Productivity Growth in U.S. Manufacturing?
affiliations: Northwestern University - Department of Economics and Northwestern University

detail.title: Does the Import Invasion Explain the Mysterious Disappearance of Productivity Growth in U.S. Manufacturing?
detail.abstract:
Why did U.S. manufacturing productivity stop growing after 2010? Productivity growth disappeared, evaporating from an annual rate of +3.3 percent during 1987-2010 to -0.3 percent from 2010 to 2023. This paper shifts attention from 2010 as the start of the puzzle to a decade earlier when output stopped growing. This cessation of output growth in 2000 is attributed to the invasion of imports that closed domestic plants, destroyed jobs, and squeezed profits. Then followed a chain of causation that ultimately undermined productivity growth – from falling capacity utilization, to lower investment in fixed capital and R&D, and to an erosion of innovation. Beyond the import invasion, the paper identifies a set of handicaps ranging from self-inflicted wounds by private manufacturing firms to a marked reduction in government-funded R&D spending. Corporate funds were diverted from productive investment to share buybacks. Investment was distorted by environmental, health, safety, and fuel economy regulations. Innovation slowed not only because of diminishing returns to R&D, but also because of a decline in public R&D, and a diversion of private R&D from basic science and process improvements to product refinements and brand extensions. Skilled worker shortages have plagued manufacturing for decades in the absence of sufficient public and private investment in vocational training.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了美国制造业生产率在2010年后停滞增长的原因，认为根源可追溯至2000年产出增长停滞，主要由于进口冲击导致工厂关闭、就业减少和利润压缩，进而引发产能利用率下降、固定资本和研发投资减少以及创新侵蚀。此外，企业资金转向股票回购、环境与安全法规扭曲投资、公共研发资金削减、私人研发偏离基础科学以及技术工人短缺等因素也加剧了这一问题。
AI.research_question: 为什么美国制造业生产率在2010年后停止增长？
AI.motivation: 美国制造业生产率从1987-2010年间年均增长3.3%骤降至2010-2023年间的-0.3%，消失的生产率增长是一个重要的经济谜题，需要解释其成因。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生产率增长停滞的因果链理论：进口冲击→产出停止增长→产能利用率下降→固定资本和研发投资减少→创新侵蚀→生产率增长停滞。
AI.method: 基于历史数据和因果链条分析的描述性研究，将时间线从2010年回溯至2000年进行诊断性分析。
AI.findings: 1) 生产率停滞的根源在2000年产出增长停止；2) 进口冲击是产出停止增长的主因；3) 因果链：进口冲击→产能利用率下降→投资减少→创新侵蚀→生产率停滞；4) 自伤行为如股票回购、环保安全法规、公共研发削减、私人研发偏离基础科学、技术工人短缺等加剧了问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 将生产率增长停滞的分析时间点从2010年提前至2000年，揭示了进口冲击通过因果链传导至生产率增长停滞的机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了解决美国制造业生产率停滞的多维视角，包括贸易政策、研发投资方向、企业治理、职业培训等方面的政策启示。

title: War and the Macroeconomy: 200 Years of Evidence
affiliations: Amazon

detail.title: War and the Macroeconomy: 200 Years of Evidence
detail.abstract: How long do the economic costs of war last? A large literature documents that war reduces GDP, but cannot say whether these losses are permanent or transitory. We construct a novel dataset of 970 conflict episodes spanning 1816 to 2023, coding each along two dimensions of intensity: physical destruction and economic mobilization. Using local projections on 200 years of GDP data, we estimate impulse responses at horizons up to 30 years. High-intensity wars reduce GDP per capita by 8 to 10 percent within five years, with the most devastating conflicts producing declines approaching 19 percent. But these costs are entirely transitory. Regardless of magnitude, channel, era, or war type, GDP per capita recovers fully within 15 to 20 years. Destruction determines the depth of the trough. Duration and war type determine the speed of recovery. But the long-run destination is always the same. These findings represent a striking vindication of neoclassical convergence dynamics and a rejection of the hysteresis hypothesis across two centuries of conflict.

AI.tldr: 基于1816-2023年970次冲突事件的新数据集，研究发现战争对人均GDP的影响完全是暂时的：高强度战争在5年内使GDP下降8-10%，但无论战争规模、类型或时期，经济都能在15-20年内完全恢复，这支持了新古典收敛动态，否定了滞后假说。
AI.research_question: 战争的经济成本会持续多久？这些损失是永久性的还是暂时性的？
AI.motivation: 大量文献记录了战争会降低GDP，但无法说明这些损失是永久性的还是暂时性的。本研究旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 新古典收敛动态（neoclassical convergence dynamics）与滞后假说（hysteresis hypothesis）的对立。
AI.method: 构建了1816-2023年970次冲突事件的新数据集，按物理破坏和经济动员两个维度编码冲突强度，使用局部投影法（local projections）对200年GDP数据进行30年跨度的脉冲响应估计。
AI.findings: 高强度战争在5年内使人均GDP下降8-10%，最严重的冲突可导致下降约19%。但这些成本完全是暂时的，无论规模、渠道、时代或战争类型，人均GDP都能在15-20年内完全恢复。破坏程度决定衰退深度，持续时间和战争类型决定恢复速度。
AI.theory_contributions: 研究结果有力地支持了新古典收敛动态假说，明确拒绝了滞后假说，验证了经济在遭受重大冲击后具有回归长期增长路径的内在能力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为战后经济重建政策提供了重要启示：由于经济具有自我修复能力，政策应聚焦于促进恢复过程而非担忧永久性损失；同时揭示了不同战争类型和持续时间对恢复速度的差异化影响。

title: Beliefs and Stock Market Fluctuations: New Evidence from the Past Seven Decades
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Sloan School of Management and Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Sloan School of Management

detail.title: Beliefs and Stock Market Fluctuations: New Evidence from the Past Seven Decades
detail.abstract:
We construct a new long-run series of subjective expected equity returns from an independent equity analysis firm, spanning 1956-2024. These expected returns are strongly positively correlated with the earnings-price ratio, respond negatively to past returns, and predict future returns. These patterns contrast with subjective expectations of individual investors and professional forecasters, which are weakly or negatively correlated with our new measure. Disagreement between sophisticated and individual investors is associated with higher trading volume. Our findings are consistent with a model of heterogeneous beliefs, where naive investors extrapolate past returns, rather than past dividends, while sophisticated investors are close to rational.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文利用一家独立股权分析公司1956-2024年的数据，构建了新的主观预期股票收益率长期序列。研究发现，这些预期收益率与盈利-价格比正相关，对过去收益率负向反应，并能预测未来收益率——这与散户和专业预测者的主观预期模式形成鲜明对比。聪明投资者与散户之间的意见分歧与更高的交易量相关。研究结果支持异质信念模型：散户投资者是幼稚的（外推过去收益率而非股息），而聪明投资者接近理性。
AI.research_question: 聪明投资者（机构/专业分析师）的主观预期股票收益率具有怎样的特征？它与散户和专业预测者的预期有何不同？对市场行为有何解释？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注散户或专业预测者的主观预期，但缺乏对"聪明投资者"（如专业股权分析机构）长期主观预期序列的构建与分析。作者希望通过新数据揭示聪明投资者预期的特征，并解释其在市场中的角色。
AI.theoretical_framework: 异质信念模型（Heterogeneous Beliefs）：假设市场上存在两类投资者——幼稚投资者（散户）外推过去收益率，聪明投资者（专业机构）接近理性。两类投资者的预期差异可以解释交易量等市场现象。
AI.method: 基于一家独立股权分析公司1956-2024年的数据构建主观预期股票收益率序列；采用时间序列分析考察该序列与盈利-价格比、过去收益率、未来实际收益率的关系；与已有的散户预期、专业预测者预期数据进行对比分析。
AI.findings: 1）聪明投资者预期与盈利-价格比强正相关；2）聪明投资者预期对过去收益率负向反应（而非正向外推）；3）聪明投资者预期能正向预测未来收益率；4）聪明投资者与散户预期之间的分歧越大，市场交易量越高；5）散户和专业预测者的预期模式与聪明投资者相反（弱相关或负相关）。
AI.theory_contributions: 为异质信念模型提供了直接的经验证据，区分了聪明投资者与幼稚投资者在预期形成机制上的系统性差异，并揭示了预期分歧对交易量的解释力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为市场参与者理解不同投资者群体的预期行为提供了参考；帮助解释市场交易量的来源；对资产定价和投资策略有潜在启示。

title: Dynamic Covariance Transfer in Multi-Yield Curve Models with Applications to Actuarial Valuation
affiliations: , University of California Santa Barbara and

detail.title: Dynamic Covariance Transfer in Multi-Yield Curve Models with Applications to Actuarial Valuation
detail.abstract: Insurers and asset managers looking to hedge and effectively manage risk associated with diverse fixed-income portfolios are faced with the challenging task of modeling simultaneous exposures across collections of dynamic and potentially highly correlated sovereign yield curves. To address this task, we present a novel multi-yield curve model capable of capturing the time-evolving dynamic covariance structures across term structures of arbitrarily many sovereign yield curves. Through use of a novel cointegration-based approach to feature extraction, the model is able to construct a representation of these cross-curve dynamics that allows for meaningful economic interpretation. The model is exceptionally effective in a stress testing setting, as the aforementioned feature extraction mechanism and framework for cross-curve covariance characterization allow for the model to both capture the direct effect of local and global shocks, as well as any cross-asset transmission of these shocks across systems of sovereign fixed-income markets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新型多收益率曲线模型，利用协整特征提取方法，能够捕捉多个主权债券收益率曲线之间的动态协方差结构，并有效用于压力测试和风险管理。
AI.research_question: 如何对多个动态且高度相关的国家主权收益率曲线进行联合建模，以有效管理固定收益投资组合的风险？
AI.motivation: 保险公司和资产管理公司在管理多样化固定收益投资组合时，面临同时建模多个动态且高度相关的主权收益率曲线的挑战，现有模型难以捕捉跨曲线间的时变协方差结构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 协整分析（Cointegration）、特征提取、动态协方差结构建模、跨资产风险传导机制
AI.method: 基于协整的特征提取方法，构建多收益率曲线模型，捕捉跨曲线动态协方差结构，并在压力测试场景中验证模型效果。
AI.findings: 模型能够有效捕捉本地和全球冲击的直接效应，以及这些冲击在主权固定收益市场体系中的跨资产传导效应，在压力测试场景中表现尤为出色。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种新颖的协整特征提取方法，用于构建可解释的跨收益率曲线动态表征，推动了多资产收益率曲线联合建模的理论发展。
AI.practical_contributions: 为保险公司和资产管理公司提供了一种有效的风险管理工具，能够更好地对冲和管理多样化固定收益组合中的利率风险及跨市场风险传导。

title: The risk of Mpox false positive results in high transmission settings: evidence from a multi-site observational study in DR Congo

detail.abstract:
Background: Environmental viral burden is a recognized challenge for DNA viruses, with highly sensitive qPCR assays capable of detecting monkeypox virus (MPXV) DNA in the absence of viable virus. The impact of such environmental burden on routine mpox diagnosis and case ascertainment during outbreaks has not previously been quantified. 

Methods: We collected cycle threshold (Ct) values from 2,724 qPCR-tested persons with mpox compatible illness attending mpox treatment centers across four locations in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and conducted surface sampling of clinic and laboratory environments at two locations. We developed a Bayesian latent class model to distinguish qPCR-positive results of true MPXV infections from those consistent with environmentally-derived MPXV DNA. We estimated the proportion of qPCR-positive results attributable to environmental viral burden by clinical and demographic factors and diagnostic Ct thresholds. Model-based classifications were externally evaluated using longitudinal serologic data from a subset of participants. 

Findings: We estimate that 35% (95%CrI: 31-39%) of qPCR results with Ct<40, were consistent with environmental burden of MPXV DNA, rather than true infection. Among a subset of participants with serological data, 76% (13/17) of those inferred as environmentally-derived false positives had no serologic evidence of orthopoxvirus infection compared to 0% in those inferred as likely true infections (0/5). Lowering the diagnostic threshold to Ct<37 reduced the false positive proportion to 8% (95% CrI: 7–9%) and to 2% (95% CrI: 1–3%) at Ct<34, with only marginal losses in sensitivity. 

Interpretation: More than one in three qPCR-positive mpox diagnoses in high-burden settings may have been driven by environmental viral burden, with serological data independently supporting this finding. Strengthened decontamination of clinical areas, lower Ct thresholds, and additional investigation of high-Ct specimens, including clinical progressions, epidemiologic links, and repeat testing, could substantially improve diagnostic specificity while preserving sensitivity.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现，在猴痘高负担环境中，超过三分之一（35%）的qPCR阳性结果实际上是由环境病毒污染而非真正感染导致的。将诊断阈值从Ct<40降低至Ct<34可将假阳性比例降至2%，且灵敏度损失极小。
AI.research_question: 环境病毒负担对猴痘常规qPCR诊断和病例确定的影响有多大？多大比例的qPCR阳性结果可归因于环境病毒DNA而非真正感染？
AI.motivation: 此前从未有研究量化环境病毒负担对猴痘诊断的影响。由于qPCR检测高度敏感，即使环境中存在非活病毒DNA也可能导致假阳性，这在高负担地区可能严重影响疫情监测和病例报告的准确性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境病毒负担理论（环境中的非活性病毒DNA导致qPCR假阳性）、贝叶斯潜在类别模型（用于区分真正感染与环境来源的阳性结果）
AI.method: 收集刚果（金）四个地点2724例qPCR检测的Ct值，并在两个地点进行环境表面采样；开发贝叶斯潜在类别模型区分真正感染与环境来源的qPCR阳性；利用纵向血清学数据对模型分类进行外部验证。
AI.findings: 35%的Ct<40的qPCR阳性结果符合环境病毒DNA负担而非真正感染；血清学数据验证了模型推断（环境来源假阳性中76%无血清学证据，真正感染中0%无血清学证据）；将阈值降至Ct<37可将假阳性率降至8%，Ct<34降至2%，灵敏度损失极小。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次量化了环境病毒负担对猴痘qPCR诊断假阳性的贡献程度，为理解高敏感核酸检测在DNA病毒诊断中的局限性提供了新证据；验证了贝叶斯潜在类别模型在区分感染与环境污染方面的有效性。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议在高负担环境中加强临床区域的消毒；建议采用更低的Ct阈值（如Ct<37或Ct<34）以提高诊断特异性；建议对高Ct值标本进行额外调查，包括临床进展追踪、流行病学关联分析和重复检测。

detail.abstract:
Background: Target trial emulation enables estimation of vaccine effectiveness using electronic health registries of patient data by emulating a hypothetical randomised controlled trial. Our study aimed to use target trial emulation to estimate COVID-19 vaccine effectiveness among children and adolescents in Japan.

Methods: We conducted our target trial emulation using data from three national registries and estimated the COVID-19 vaccine effectiveness for 12-17-year-old adolescents and 5-11-year-old children in Japan. Vaccinated individuals were matched 1:1 with unvaccinated controls based on age, sex, and city of residence. The primary and secondary outcomes were COVID-19 infection and severe COVID-19 disease, respectively. We conducted survival analyses using Cox proportional hazards models to estimate vaccine effectiveness.

Findings: Of 1,798,929 eligible participants, 440,122 adolescent pairs and 187,443 child pairs were matched for the primary series. Among adolescents, COVID-19 vaccine effectiveness for primary series was low at 9.6% against infection and 15.3% against severe disease. Among children, vaccine effectiveness for primary series was also low at 39.3% against infection and 40.0% against severe disease. Booster doses restored vaccine effectiveness to moderate levels in both groups. Updated vaccine formulations targeting Omicron variants outperformed original-strain vaccines. Across all analyses, vaccines maintained relatively higher protection against severe disease than against infection.

Interpretation: COVID-19 vaccines offered relatively higher protection against severe disease in comparison to protection against infection among children and adolescents in Japan. Viral evolution and formulation-variant mismatch affected vaccine effectiveness, highlighting the importance of timely booster campaigns with formulations matched to circulating variants.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用目标试验模拟方法，基于日本三个国家登记处的数据，评估了COVID-19疫苗在儿童和青少年中的有效性。研究发现，基础免疫对感染和重症的保护效果较低，但加强针可恢复至中等水平，且针对奥密克戎的更新疫苗效果优于原始株疫苗。疫苗对重症的保护效果始终优于对感染的保护效果。
AI.research_question: 在日本儿童和青少年中，COVID-19疫苗（基础免疫和加强针）对感染和重症疾病的保护效果如何？
AI.motivation: 目标试验模拟方法可以利用电子健康登记数据评估疫苗效果，但该方法在儿童和青少年群体中的应用尚不充分。日本需要针对该群体的真实世界疫苗效果证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 目标试验模拟（Target Trial Emulation）框架；Cox比例风险模型生存分析。
AI.method: 使用日本三个国家登记处的数据，将接种者与未接种者按年龄、性别和居住城市进行1:1匹配。采用Cox比例风险模型进行生存分析，估计疫苗对COVID-19感染（主要结局）和重症COVID-19（次要结局）的保护效果。
AI.findings: 1) 共匹配440,122对青少年和187,443对儿童。2) 青少年基础免疫对感染的保护效果为9.6%，对重症为15.3%。3) 儿童基础免疫对感染的保护效果为39.3%，对重症为40.0%。4) 加强针可将保护效果恢复至中等水平。5) 针对奥密克戎变异株的更新疫苗效果优于原始株疫苗。6) 疫苗对重症的保护始终优于对感染的保护。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了目标试验模拟方法在儿童和青少年疫苗效果评估中的适用性；揭示了病毒变异与疫苗配方不匹配对疫苗效果的显著影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为日本儿童和青少年COVID-19疫苗接种策略提供真实世界证据；强调了及时开展与流行变异株匹配的加强针接种运动的重要性。

title: Identifying Circular Public Procurement with Large Language Models: An Application to Firm-Level Circular Innovation
affiliations: KU Leuven - Department of Managerial Economics, Strategy, and Innovation, ZEW - Leibniz Centre for European Research, Ghent University and KU Leuven - Faculty of Economics and Business

detail.title: Identifying Circular Public Procurement with Large Language Models: An Application to Firm-Level Circular Innovation

publicationDetails.detailsText: ZEW – Centre for European Economic Research Discussion Paper No. 26-019

detail.abstract: Policy makers increasingly recognize circular public procurement as a demandpull instrument for stimulating the transition to a circular economy. However, empirical studies on circular public procurement have been hampered by a fundamental measurement challenge, as public procurement databases do not contain structured ways of identifying circular projects. This paper presents the first application of an LLM-based semantic similarity approach to identify circular procurement at scale. Adapting a bibliometric text-embedding approach from circular economy research, we show its application in comparing tender descriptions to a reference corpus of circular economy scientific abstracts, generating circularity scores for each award. We then apply the identified circular public procurement awards in an empirical study of firm-level adoption of circular economy innovation, matching the classified tenders to German data from the Community Innovation Survey. The results show that firms winning circular procurement are more likely to introduce circular economy innovation after three to five years, while no significant results are found at shorter or longer time horizons. Overall, this paper demonstrates the potential of using LLMs to identify circular public procurement and study its effectiveness in enabling the circular transition.

AI.tldr: 本文首次利用大语言模型（LLM）的语义相似性方法，从公开采购数据库中大规模识别循环采购项目，并实证发现赢得循环采购的企业在3-5年后更可能引入循环经济创新。
AI.research_question: 如何利用LLM大规模识别循环公共采购？循环公共采购能否推动企业采用循环经济创新？
AI.motivation: 循环公共采购被视为促进循环经济转型的需求端工具，但现有实证研究因采购数据库缺乏结构化标识而难以大规模识别循环采购项目，存在根本性的测量挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 循环经济理论、需求拉动创新理论、语义相似性嵌入方法（基于LLM的文本嵌入与参考语料库对比）
AI.method: 采用LLM驱动的语义相似性方法（借鉴文献计量学的文本嵌入），将采购标书描述与循环经济科学摘要的参考语料库进行对比，生成每项采购的"循环性分数"；随后将识别的循环采购匹配至德国社区创新调查（CIS）的企业层面数据，分析其对企业采用循环创新的影响。
AI.findings: 赢得循环采购的企业在3-5年后引入循环经济创新的可能性显著提高；但在更短或更长的时间窗口上未发现显著效果。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将LLM语义相似性方法应用于循环采购的大规模识别，解决了该领域长期存在的测量难题；为需求拉动创新理论提供了循环经济情境下的实证证据，揭示了时间维度的非线性和滞后效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了可操作的大规模监测和评估循环采购的工具；帮助企业理解参与循环采购对长期创新能力的影响，为循环经济转型提供数据支撑。

title: Opioid Epidemic and Mortgage Default

detail.title: Opioid Epidemic and Mortgage Default
detail.abstract: I study how local health shocks affect mortgage default and credit supply. Using variation from the 2010 reformulation of OxyContin, I show that increases in opioid abuse raise mortgage delinquency rates. These effects arise without corresponding declines in local income or employment and are concentrated in high loan-to-value areas, consistent with a collateral channel. I further show that lenders tighten credit supply in more exposed areas, highlighting how localized shocks can amplify financial distress through housing markets.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了地方性健康冲击（阿片类药物滥用增加）如何通过抵押品渠道影响抵押贷款违约和信贷供给。
AI.research_question: 地方性健康冲击（阿片类药物滥用）如何影响抵押贷款违约率和信贷供给？
AI.motivation: 既有文献较少关注健康冲击通过住房抵押品渠道影响金融市场的机制，本文利用奥施康定2010年配方改革作为外生冲击，填补了这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 抵押品渠道（collateral channel）：健康冲击导致药物滥用增加，进而推高抵押贷款违约率，且该效应在高贷款价值比（LTV）地区更为显著，而并非通过收入或就业渠道传导。
AI.method: 利用奥施康定2010年配方改革作为外生变异的准自然实验方法。
AI.findings: （1）阿片类药物滥用增加显著提高了抵押贷款拖欠率；（2）该效应并非由当地收入或就业下降驱动；（3）效应集中出现在高贷款价值比地区；（4）银行在暴露程度更高的地区收紧信贷供给。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了健康冲击通过抵押品渠道影响住房市场和金融稳定的机制，拓展了健康经济学与家庭金融的交叉研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构和金融机构识别和应对地方性健康冲击引发的系统性金融风险提供了实证依据。

detail.abstract:
Combustible herbal, or “non-tobacco”, cigarettes are often advertised as healthier than tobacco cigarettes and as non-addictive, due to their lack of nicotine. In May 2026, we discovered a US-based website promoting a “non-tobacco” combustible cigarette product that appears to contain a nicotine analogue. The brand name of the product is “ChoiceTM Smokes”, marketed by Signature Brands of America LLC. ChoiceTM cigarettes are sold online and locally in the US for a significantly lower price than regular tobacco cigarettes, and are available from age 18 on, younger than the age limit of 21 for tobacco sales in the US. ChoiceTM cigarettes are marketed with the slogan “No tobacco. No nicotine. No Problem”.

Instead of nicotine, ChoiceTM contain a nicotine substitute named “NOVARA™”, that, according to legal documents posted by the company, appears to be 6-methyl nicotine, a poorly characterized nicotinic receptor agonist likely more potent and toxic than nicotine.

The availability of products such as ChoiceTM “non-tobacco” cigarettes undermines tobacco control regulations and raise concerns about potential health and addiction risks. Legislators, regulators and tobacco control advocates need to clarify the status of nicotine analogue-containing products and allow their effective regulation with the goal of improving public health.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示美国市场上出现名为"ChoiceTM Smokes"的新型可燃草药香烟，声称不含烟草和尼古丁，但实际含有未被充分研究的尼古丁类似物——6-甲基尼古丁（NOVARA™），其效力与毒性可能高于尼古丁。该产品以低价、低年龄门槛销售，规避了现行烟草管制法规，对公共健康构成潜在威胁。
AI.research_question: 美国市场上声称"无烟草、无尼古丁"的可燃草药香烟产品是否真的安全无害？其成分和营销方式对烟草管制法规与公共健康构成何种挑战？
AI.motivation: 研究动机源于2026年5月发现美国一家网站推广名为"ChoiceTM Smokes"的非烟草可燃香烟产品，该产品声称不含尼古丁却含有尼古丁类似物（6-甲基尼古丁），以低于普通香烟的价格和更宽松的年龄限制（18岁而非21岁）进行销售，可能严重规避现有烟草管制政策并威胁公共健康。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 尼古丁类似物药理学：6-甲基尼古丁作为烟碱型乙酰胆碱受体激动剂的效力与毒性分析；2. 烟草管制政策框架：美国烟草销售年龄限制（21岁）与食品、药品监管法规；3. 公共健康危害评估理论：成瘾性、毒性及健康风险的流行病学原理。
AI.method: 1. 网络监测：发现并追踪在线销售平台；2. 文献与法律文件分析：查阅公司公开的法律文件中关于"NOVARA™"成分的描述；3. 化学与药理比较分析：将6-甲基尼古丁与普通尼古丁进行受体结合效力与毒性对比。
AI.findings: 1. ChoiceTM Smokes产品含有名为"NOVARA™"的尼古丁替代物，经鉴定为6-甲基尼古丁；2. 该物质是一种研究尚不充分的烟碱型乙酰胆碱受体激动剂，效力与毒性可能高于天然尼古丁；3. 该产品以"无烟草、无尼古丁、没问题"为营销口号，误导消费者认为其无害且非成瘾性；4. 产品价格显著低于传统烟草香烟，且仅要求18岁购买年龄（低于美国烟草法定21岁），严重削弱烟草管制效果。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统揭示了美国市场尼古丁类似物（6-甲基尼古丁）在可燃草药香烟中的商业应用；2. 填补了关于6-甲基尼古丁作为尼古丁替代品在成瘾性与毒性方面的研究空白；3. 为烟草管制理论提供了新型"尼古丁类似物规避政策"的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 警示立法者与监管机构需明确界定尼古丁类似物产品的法律地位；2. 呼吁将含有尼古丁类似物的产品纳入有效监管范围；3. 为公共健康政策制定者提供及时的风险预警信息，支持制定针对新型烟草替代品的年龄限制、广告规范和价格监管措施。

title: Immigration: Are H-1B Workers Paid Less than Their Native Counterparts?
affiliations: Georgetown University - School of Medicine

detail.title: Immigration: Are H-1B Workers Paid Less than Their Native Counterparts?
detail.abstract: Recently a $100,000 tax was imposed on any foreign worker entering the US with an H-1B visa procured abroad. It is said that this tax was inspired by an analysis of data that showed H-1B workers are paid substantially (~15%) less than native workers. However, I found that in most cases the wage gap is positive, not negative. Most (~66%) of the H-1B workers in the dataset transitioned from F-1 (student) status to H-1B status. Transitioning to H-1B from other visas, like for skilled multinational employees and managers, persons with extraordinary abilities, or NAFTA-linked workers, all show positive wage gaps. Only for H-1B workers (~21% of them) transitioning from visas like for victims of crime or abuse, tourists, exchange visitors, crewmembers, spouses or dependents of some primary skills-based visa holders, or those with temporary protected status, show a negative wage gap of about 4%.

AI.tldr: 本文发现，H-1B签证外国工人与美国本土工人之间的工资差距并非普遍为负（约15%），实际上多数情况下工资差距为正。约66%从F-1学生签证转为H-1B的工人以及从其他高技能签证转换的工人均呈现正向工资差距，仅约21%从低技能/非技能相关签证转换的H-1B工人存在约4%的负向工资差距。因此，针对H-1B工人的10万美元税收政策依据值得商榷。
AI.research_question: H-1B外国工人与美国本土工人的实际工资差距究竟如何？
AI.motivation: 美国近期对境外获得H-1B签证的外国工人征收10万美元税收，其政策依据是数据显示H-1B工人工资比本土工人低约15%。作者希望检验这一数据的准确性和结论的稳健性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 移民经济学中的工资差异理论，签证类别转换与劳动力市场选择效应。
AI.method: 对H-1B工人数据集进行细分分析，按签证转换来源（F-1学生签证、其他高技能签证、低技能/非技能相关签证）分类比较工资差距。
AI.findings: 多数情况下H-1B工人工资差距为正而非负。约66%从F-1学生签证转换的H-1B工人、以及从高管/经理、杰出人才、NAFTA工人等签证转换的工人都呈现正向工资差距。仅约21%从犯罪/虐待受害者、游客、交换访客、船员、家属或临时保护身份等签证转换的H-1B工人存在约4%的负向工资差距。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示H-1B工人群体内部存在显著的异质性，不同签证转换来源的工人工资表现截然不同，挑战了将H-1B工人视为同质群体的假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 质疑基于总体平均工资差距数据制定政策的合理性，指出针对H-1B工人的10万美元税收政策可能基于有偏的统计分析，为政策调整提供实证依据。

title: The Macroeconomic Cost of Sanctioning Coups
affiliations: Amazon

detail.title: The Macroeconomic Cost of Sanctioning Coups
detail.abstract: When the international community sanctions a coup regime, does it impose meaningful economic costs? We apply the synthetic control method to 89 coup-triggered sanctions episodes, using unsanctioned coups as counterfactuals. Sanctioned coups experience cumulative output losses of approximately 5 percentage points over six years. The effect is driven by trade sanctions and concentrated in trade-dependent economies: above-median trade openness countries lose approximately 6 percentage points, while below-median countries show effects near zero. Multilateral sanctions impose larger costs than unilateral measures. Sanctioned coups followed by democratization show no lasting GDP cost, while those without political change show losses approaching 8 percentage points. These findings suggest that sanctions can impose meaningful economic pressure, but only when they include trade restrictions and are coordinated across multiple senders.

AI.tldr: 本文利用合成控制法分析89个由政变引发的制裁案例，发现受制裁政变国家在6年内累计产出损失约5个百分点，贸易制裁和贸易依赖型经济体损失更大，多边制裁比单边制裁成本更高，且民主转型能消除制裁的经济损失。
AI.research_question: 国际社会对政变政权实施制裁是否会造成显著的经济成本？
AI.motivation: 尽管制裁被广泛用作应对政变的外交工具，但其实际经济影响缺乏系统性的因果识别证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 合成控制法（Synthetic Control Method）
AI.method: 采用合成控制法，以未受制裁的政变作为反事实对照组，分析89个由政变引发的制裁案例。
AI.findings: 1. 受制裁政变国家6年内累计产出损失约5个百分点；2. 贸易制裁是主要驱动因素；3. 贸易开放度高于中位数的国家损失约6个百分点，低于中位数的国家损失接近零；4. 多边制裁比单边制裁成本更高；5. 受制裁后实现民主化的国家无持续性GDP损失，未实现政治变革的国家损失接近8个百分点。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了关于政变制裁经济效果的系统性因果估计，区分了不同制裁类型（贸易制裁vs.非贸易制裁）、制裁主体（多边vs.单边）以及政治结果（民主化vs.无变革）的异质性影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了制裁有效性的条件证据：只有当制裁包含贸易限制且由多个行为体协调实施时，才能对政变政权施加有意义的经济压力。

title:
How Universal is the Cool Water Effect? 
Evidence from the Unlikely Case of Russia
affiliations: National Research University Higher School of Economics (Moscow), National Research University – Higher School of Economics (HSE University) and Leuphana University of Lueneburg

detail.title:
How Universal is the Cool Water Effect? 
Evidence from the Unlikely Case of Russia
detail.abstract: Elaborating on Welzel et al.'s "Cool Water Theory," our study zooms into the more limited (albeit still varied) framework conditions of Russia's huge territory. Within Russia's confines, we examine how the combination of moderately cool seasons with steady rain (i.e., Cool Water) affects sub-national areas' contemporary societal progress in two modernization indicators: material prosperity in the economic domain and emancipative values in the psychological domain. The analysis hinges on climate data, historical census materials and contemporary surveys across Russia's roughly fifty provinces. We find strong evidence that Russian regions with a more pronounced Cool Water Condition (CWC) relied early on labor-extensive forms of agriculture, which lowered reproductive pressures on women, visible in lower fertility rates. Lower historic fertilities, then, strengthened human capital formation, which eventually helped to create pathways towards higher material prosperity and stronger emancipative values. The Russian case, thus, confirms-within the confines of a more limited cultural universe-CWCinitiated modernization dynamics demonstrated before for global cross-cultural contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文在Welzel等人"冷水理论"的基础上，聚焦俄罗斯广阔领土内的特定框架条件，研究温和凉爽且降雨稳定的气候条件（即"冷水条件"）如何通过影响历史生育率、人力资本形成，最终推动当代俄罗斯各地区在经济繁荣和解放价值观方面的现代化进程。
AI.research_question: 在俄罗斯境内，温和凉爽且降雨稳定的气候条件（Cool Water Condition）如何通过影响历史农业模式、生育率和人力资本形成，进而推动各地区在物质繁荣和解放价值观方面的现代化进程？
AI.motivation: 将Welzel等人的"冷水理论"从全球跨文化比较视角缩小到俄罗斯这一相对有限但仍有差异的文化单元内进行验证，探究该理论在更具体文化语境中的适用性和机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 冷水理论（Cool Water Theory）：温和凉爽且降雨稳定的气候条件有利于劳动密集型农业向劳动节约型农业转变，降低生育率，促进人力资本积累，最终推动经济繁荣和解放价值观的形成。
AI.method: 利用俄罗斯约50个省份的气候数据、历史人口普查资料和当代调查数据，进行多阶段路径分析，检验"冷水条件→劳动节约型农业→低生育率→人力资本形成→经济繁荣与解放价值观"的因果链。
AI.findings: 俄罗斯境内"冷水条件"更显著的地区，历史上更依赖劳动节约型农业，女性生育压力降低（表现为较低生育率），进而促进人力资本积累，最终推动更高的物质繁荣水平和更强的解放价值观。该机制在俄罗斯这一相对有限的文化单元内得到验证，与全球跨文化研究结论一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 将"冷水理论"从全球宏观比较拓展到单一国家内部（俄罗斯）的区域层面验证，证明该理论在更有限的文化框架内仍具有解释力，增强了理论的普适性和稳健性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解俄罗斯各地区间经济发展和价值观差异提供了气候-历史制度视角的解释，有助于制定差异化的区域发展政策。

title:
Seeds of Institutional Change:
The Biopiracy of Brazilian Rubber
affiliations: Universita di Roma, University of the Witwatersrand and

detail.title:
Seeds of Institutional Change:
The Biopiracy of Brazilian Rubber

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no relevant or material financial interests that relate to the research presented in this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable.
declarations.funderStatement: None.

detail.abstract: How do technological breakthroughs alter the governance of common-pool resources? Economists and other social scientists have long studied commons as problems of overuse or of institutional design, dedicating less attention to how resource dynamics themselves can trigger institutional change-even across borders. This work examines a striking nineteenthcentury case: Britain's appropriation of Brazilian rubber (caoutchouc) seeds and their transplantation to Southeast Asia, an episode now widely regarded as biopiracy. Using factual and historical evidence, game-theoretic reasoning, and counterfactual analysis, it shows that vulcanization, which increased rubber's commercial value, exposed a vacuum in Brazil's formal institutions and created incentives for Britain to seize rents that Brazil could not protect. The resulting shift from wild extraction to plantation cultivation expanded global output and reduced prices. Brazil's dominance was unlikely to be sustainable under any scenario, and the unintended aggregate outcome was positive-sum, albeit with uneven consequences-a Kaldor-Hicks rather than Pareto improvement.

AI.tldr: 本文研究技术突破如何改变公共池资源的治理，以19世纪英国将巴西橡胶树移植到东南亚（现代视为生物剽窃）为例，通过历史证据、博弈论推理和反事实分析，论证硫化技术提高了橡胶的商业价值，暴露了巴西正式制度的真空，促使英国攫取巴西无法保护的租金，导致从野生采集转向 plantation 种植，全球产出增加、价格下降。巴西的支配地位在任何情境下都难以持续，最终结果是卡尔多-希克斯改进而非帕累托改进。
AI.research_question: 技术突破如何改变公共池资源的治理？尤其是当资源跨越国界时，技术变革如何触发制度变迁？
AI.motivation: 现有文献多关注公地过度使用或制度设计问题，较少关注资源动态本身如何引发制度变迁，尤其是跨越国界的制度变迁。本文以19世纪巴西橡胶被英国移植到东南亚这一历史事件（现被视为生物剽窃）为案例，填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公共池资源理论、制度变迁理论、博弈论、租金攫取理论、卡尔多-希克斯效率与帕累托改进
AI.method: 事实与历史证据分析、博弈论推理、反事实分析
AI.findings: 1. 硫化技术（vulcanization）提高了橡胶的商业价值，暴露了巴西正式制度的真空；2. 这一制度真空创造了激励，促使英国攫取巴西无法保护的租金；3. 从野生采集转向 plantation 种植，扩大了全球产出、降低了价格；4. 巴西的支配地位在任何情境下都难以持续；5. 无意的总体结果是正和博弈，但收益分配不均——属于卡尔多-希克斯改进，而非帕累托改进。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将技术变革引入公共池资源治理分析，揭示技术突破如何暴露制度真空并触发跨国的制度变迁；2. 拓展了公地研究从"过度使用/制度设计"到"资源动态引发制度变迁"的理论视角；3. 为理解生物剽窃等跨国资源攫取现象提供了制度经济学分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 对发展中国家具有警示意义：技术变革可能使本国资源价值骤升，但若正式制度薄弱，可能面临跨国资源攫取；2. 为资源富集国的制度设计提供启示：需要建立能够适应技术变革和保护资源租金的制度安排；3. 为理解全球资源治理中的"赢家与输家"问题提供分析视角，提醒政策制定者关注收益分配的不平等性。

title: The Trust-Buffer Hypothesis: Macro-prudential Resilience in the Era of Integrated Finance
affiliations: Blantyre International University

detail.title: The Trust-Buffer Hypothesis: Macro-prudential Resilience in the Era of Integrated Finance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study is a theoretical and policy-focused analysis that does not involve human participants, clinical trials, or private patient data, relying entirely on publicly available institutional reports and macroeconomic frameworks.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This article explores the transformation of systemic risk from the traditional banking and finance sector to the integrated finance landscape, with a specific focus on the emerging economies of Sub-Saharan Africa. Primary adoption of rapid scaling financial technology in mobile money in Malawi as a primary case study, where we argue that the post-2008 macro-prudential framework, while effective at stabilising commercial bank balance sheets, has failed to account for "trustbased liquidity shocks" occurring at the digital interface. We propose the Trust-Buffer Hypothesis, suggesting that in an integrated financial ecosystem, consumer confidence and digital literacy function as systemic assets. The research concludes that a lack of oversight in the shadow of fintech integration creates a gaping hole where social engineering and fraud can trigger non-linear liquidity runs that threaten the stability of the traditional banking core.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了系统性风险如何从传统银行与金融部门向整合金融格局转变，聚焦撒哈拉以南非洲新兴经济体。以马拉维移动货币中金融科技的快速扩展为主要案例，论证2008年后宏观审慎框架虽有效稳定了商业银行资产负债表，但未能应对发生在数字界面的"基于信任的流动性冲击"。提出"信任缓冲假说"，认为在整合金融生态系统中，消费者信心和数字素养充当系统性资产。结论指出，金融科技整合阴影下的监管缺失造成了巨大漏洞，社会工程和欺诈可引发非线性流动性挤兑，威胁传统银行核心的稳定。
AI.research_question: 系统性风险如何从传统银行与金融部门向整合金融格局（尤其是撒哈拉以南非洲新兴经济体的移动货币/金融科技领域）转变？
AI.motivation: 2008年后宏观审慎框架未能解释和应对数字金融界面中基于信任的流动性冲击，金融科技快速扩张但监管滞后，可能威胁传统银行体系稳定。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信任缓冲假说（Trust-Buffer Hypothesis）：消费者信心和数字素养在整合金融生态系统中充当系统性资产，其缺失可引发非线性流动性挤兑。
AI.method: 以马拉维移动货币为主要案例的定性案例研究。
AI.findings: （1）传统宏观审慎框架对数字界面信任冲击无效；（2）金融科技整合缺乏监管造成漏洞，社会工程和欺诈可引发非线性流动性挤兑；（3）信任缓冲假说解释了消费者信心和数字素养作为系统性资产的作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出信任缓冲假说，扩展了系统性风险理论，将其从传统银行资产负债表风险延伸至数字金融生态中的信任风险维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为新兴经济体金融科技监管提供启示：需将消费者数字素养、信任机制纳入宏观审慎框架，防范数字金融整合引发的系统性风险。

title: Impacts of the NATO 5% Military Spending Decision on the Economies of European NATO Member States

detail.title: Impacts of the NATO 5% Military Spending Decision on the Economies of European NATO Member States
detail.abstract: This discussion paper analyses the consequences of the NATO ‘5% decision’ adopted at the Hague summit in 2025, when all NATO members, excepting Spain, consented to raise military spending in a broad sense to at least 5% of GDP by 2035. The analysis focuses on the fiscal, economic, industrial and environmental impacts for European NATO members. It is based on a country-by-country estimation of additional military spending and arms procurement as well as increases in the share of military spending in central government expenditures and public debt. The potential effects of this major expansion of spending on economic growth, employment, innovation, arms export and procurement policies, concentration of the European arms industry and non-defence public spending, particularly development assistance and climate-related policies are discussed. The paper concludes that the 5% decision will impose a heavy fiscal burden on European NATO members, with mixed economic benefits and significant risks to debt sustainability, market competition, development goals and climate targets. Careful design of financing mechanisms, transparent reporting, stricter regulation of arms producers and balanced policy choices will be essential to mitigate potentially large adverse wider effects of increased military spending.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了北约2025年海牙峰会通过的“5%决定”（即北约成员国到2035年将军费开支提高到GDP的5%）对欧洲成员国在财政、经济、工业和环境方面的影响。研究发现，这一决定将带来沉重的财政负担，经济增长效益参差不齐，并对债务可持续性、市场竞争、发展目标和气候目标构成重大风险。
AI.research_question: 北约“5%决定”（到2035年将军费提高至GDP的5%）对欧洲北约成员国在财政、经济、工业和环境方面会产生哪些影响？
AI.motivation: 2025年海牙峰会通过了北约“5%决定”，这是北约历史上最大规模的军费扩张计划，但其对欧洲成员国可能产生的广泛经济、财政、产业和环境影响尚未得到系统分析，亟需评估这一重大政策决策的后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 军费开支对经济增长的影响理论（如凯恩斯乘数效应与挤出效应）、公共债务可持续性理论、国防工业经济学、军备竞赛与安全困境理论。
AI.method: 逐国估算新增军费开支和武器采购规模；分析军费在中央政府支出和公共债务中占比的变化；讨论军费扩张对经济增长、就业、创新、军备出口与采购政策、欧洲军工业集中度、非国防公共支出（特别是发展援助和气候政策）的潜在影响。
AI.findings: ①“5%决定”将给欧洲北约成员国带来沉重的财政负担；②经济增长效益存在不确定性，利弊参半；③债务可持续性面临显著风险；④市场竞争可能受到抑制；⑤发展援助和气候目标（非国防公共支出）将受到挤压。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统评估了超大规模军费扩张（GDP的5%）这一极端情境下对多维度（财政、经济、产业、环境）的综合影响，拓展了军费开支研究的边界条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 为北约成员国政策制定者提供了关于军费扩张潜在负面效应的预警；指出需要精心设计融资机制、透明报告制度、对军工企业更严格的监管以及平衡的政策选择，以减轻军费增加带来的不利影响。

title: Tax Performance and the Political Settlement in Uganda: 1962-2023

detail.title: Tax Performance and the Political Settlement in Uganda: 1962-2023
detail.abstract: This chapter examines a largely neglected dimension of tax policy evaluation: the extent to which political institutions shape economic activity, policy choices, and the state’s fiscal capacity. It employs political settlement analysis within a historical framework, complemented by a simple OLS regression model. Drawing on the Effective States and Inclusive Development PolSett Dataset (2022), the chapter analyses Uganda’s tax performance over a 61-year period, from 1962 to 2023, against the 12 political settlements that have characterised the country since independence. The findings indicate that more than 50% of Uganda’s persistently weak tax performance is significantly associated with the fragility of the political settlements under which the state has been governed. Four central insights emerge. First, taxation should be conceptualised as a political bargain through which credible commitments are made and honoured by all parties, thereby establishing an inclusive politico-fiscal contract. Second, Uganda’s history of political fragility has generated recurrent budgetary constraints, limiting the state’s capacity to fulfil its obligations within this fiscal contract. Third, the country’s tax policy framework has been distorted by political clientelism. Fourth, the NRM regime exhibits signs of political fatigue, implying that, in the absence of substantive political reforms, Uganda risks reverting to the instability that characterised the pre-1986 period. The chapter therefore argues that Uganda’s tax revenue mobilisation strategy must go beyond technical tax administration reforms and incorporate mechanisms for building a credible, stable, and inclusive political settlement as the institutional foundation for sustainable fiscal capacity.

AI.tldr: 本文通过政治定居点分析框架，研究乌干达1962-2023年间12个政治定居点与税收绩效的关系，发现超过50%的税收疲弱与政治定居点的脆弱性显著相关，提出税收应被视为政治讨价还价的包容性财政契约，并指出缺乏政治改革将导致乌干达重回不稳定状态。
AI.research_question: 政治制度在多大程度上塑造了经济活动、政策选择和国家财政能力？乌干达的政治定居点如何影响其税收绩效？
AI.motivation: 税收政策评估中一个被忽视的维度是政治制度的作用，作者希望填补这一空白，并解释乌干达长期税收疲弱的深层政治原因。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治定居点分析（Political Settlement Analysis）；财政契约理论（Fiscal Contract）；政治客户主义（Political Clientelism）
AI.method: 历史框架下的政治定居点分析，辅以简单OLS回归模型；数据来源为Effective States and Inclusive Development PolSett Dataset (2022)
AI.findings: 1）乌干达超过50%的税收疲弱与政治定居点脆弱性显著相关；2）税收应被视为包容性政治-财政契约中的可信承诺；3）政治脆弱性导致预算约束，削弱国家履约能力；4）政治客户主义扭曲了税收政策框架；5）NRM政权显现政治疲劳，缺乏改革将导致重回不稳定。
AI.theory_contributions: 将政治定居点分析引入税收政策评估领域，揭示了政治制度稳定性对财政能力的基础性作用，丰富了财政契约理论在发展中国家中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 指出乌干达税收增收策略必须超越技术性税收管理改革，建立可信、稳定、包容的政治定居点作为可持续财政能力的制度基础。

title: Education of Economy in the Global Context Trends, Challenges, and Opportunities for Peace by Design SDG's
affiliations: , Universitas Negeri Jakarta, Bhayangkara Jakarta Raya University, President Republik Indonesia, Ministry of Primary and Secondary Education, President of France, Universitas Pertahanan Indonesia, Universitas Pembangunan Nasional Veteran Jakarta, Universitas Negeri Jakarta, International Islamic University of Malaysia (IIUM), Students, Universitas Nasional (UNAS), Universitas Nasional (UNAS), ,  and Universitas Pertahanan Indonesia

detail.title: Education of Economy in the Global Context Trends, Challenges, and Opportunities for Peace by Design SDG's

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
