title: The Federal Government's Discretionary Spending
affiliations: Harvard University, Harvard Kennedy School and Arbroath Associates

detail.title: The Federal Government's Discretionary Spending
detail.abstract:
This paper examines federal discretionary spending, including its place in the overall budget, its composition, and the economic and political forces shaping its size. Both defense and nondefense discretionary spending show no trend relative to national output over the past three decades, reflecting underlying factors rather than explicit targets. This stability implies a less favorable fiscal outlook than appears in official projections. Because discretionary spending is generally set annually, it will face continuing pressure from concerns about rising federal debt, a challenge compounded by the erosion of the structured budget process envisioned in the Budget Act fifty years ago.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了美国联邦可自由支配支出（包括国防与非国防）在过去三十年占GDP比重保持稳定，但这并非源于明确目标，而是潜在经济和政治力量作用的结果。这种稳定意味着财政前景比官方预测更为严峻，随着联邦债务上升，年度拨款的 discretionary spending 将面临持续压力，而五十年前《预算法案》构想的结构化预算程序也已被侵蚀。
AI.research_question: 联邦可自由支配支出的规模、构成及其背后的经济和政治决定因素是什么？这种稳定趋势对财政前景有何影响？
AI.motivation: 官方财政预测可能过于乐观，需要理解 discretionary spending 的实际动态及其对财政可持续性的真实影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 预算政治经济学、财政可持续性理论、预算制度变迁理论
AI.method: 描述性统计分析、历史趋势分析、制度分析
AI.findings: 1）过去三十年国防与非国防 discretionary spending 占GDP比重均无趋势性变化；2）这种稳定是由潜在因素而非明确目标驱动；3）稳定意味着财政前景比官方预测更不乐观；4）年度拨款机制使该类支出面临债务上升压力；5）1974年《预算法案》设定的结构化预算程序已被侵蚀。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了 discretionary spending 无趋势稳定背后的结构性成因，丰富了预算政治经济学中关于支出刚性与财政纪律的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为 policymakers 提供财政预警：当前支出稳定不可持续，年度拨款压力与预算程序退化将加剧财政挑战，需重新审视预算制度改革。

title: Measurement of “Computer Software and Accessories” Inflation
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System and

detail.title: Measurement of “Computer Software and Accessories” Inflation

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: From November 2025 to March 2026, the "Computer Software and Accessories" category of the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index made an unprecedented contribution to the rise in core and core goods inflation. Figure 1 shows the historical average since 2000 for core and core goods inflation while excluding software (blue bars) along with the contribution of software (gray bars).

AI.tldr: 本文分析了2025年11月至2026年3月期间，PCE价格指数中"计算机软件及配件"类别对核心通胀和核心商品通胀的 unprecedented 贡献，并通过图示展示了剔除软件影响后的历史平均通胀水平与软件贡献的对比。
AI.research_question: 计算机软件及配件类别对核心PCE通胀和核心商品通胀的贡献程度如何？
AI.motivation: 2025年11月至2026年3月期间，"计算机软件及配件"类别对核心通胀和核心商品通胀的贡献达到了前所未有的水平，值得深入分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 通胀解构分析、PCE价格指数构成理论
AI.method: 通过图1展示自2000年以来的历史平均数据，比较剔除软件影响后的核心通胀和核心商品通胀（蓝色柱）与软件贡献（灰色柱）的差异。
AI.findings: 在2025年11月至2026年3月期间，"计算机软件及配件"类别对核心通胀和核心商品通胀的上升做出了前所未有的贡献。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了软件类别在特定时期对整体通胀指标的异常影响，丰富了通胀构成分析的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和市场分析师在解读通胀数据时提供了重要参考，提示需关注软件类别对核心通胀指标的短期冲击。

title: Towards a Methodology for Measuring Rental Property Ownership in the United States
affiliations: Harvard University Department of Economics, Harvard University, Yale University - Department of Economics, UC Berkeley, Yale University and U.S. Census Bureau

detail.title: Towards a Methodology for Measuring Rental Property Ownership in the United States
detail.abstract:
Roughly one-third of U.S. households rent their homes, yet measuring who owns rental property is difficult: ownership is frequently obscured by LLCs, partnerships, and other intermediary entities that separate legal from economic control. We develop a method that traces ownership through administrative records — combining deeds and property assessments with the Census Bureau's Business Register, IRS Schedule K-1 filings, and SEC filings on REITs — to identify ultimate owners and construct property portfolios across the full landlord size distribution. Applying the method to 11 large CBSAs, we find that individual landlords own a large majority of rental units, though their share varies meaningfully across markets. We also show that the widely used mailing-address aggregation approach both under- and over-states portfolio size in systematic ways. The method is designed to scale to national coverage and to support measurement of landlord identity, portfolio composition, and ownership concentration in U.S. rental markets. We also discuss the method's current limitations and outline directions for refinement and validation.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种通过行政记录追溯租赁房产最终所有者的方法，发现个人房东拥有绝大多数租赁单元，并揭示了传统邮寄地址聚合方法的系统性偏差。
AI.research_question: 如何准确识别美国租赁房产的最终所有者并衡量其投资组合规模？
AI.motivation: 美国约三分之一的家庭租房居住，但租赁房产的所有权结构常被LLC、合伙企业等中间实体掩盖，导致难以区分法律控制与经济控制。现有方法（如邮寄地址聚合）存在系统性偏差。
AI.theoretical_framework: 所有权追溯方法、行政记录链接、房东规模分布理论
AI.method: 结合契据、房产评估、人口普查局商业登记、IRS Schedule K-1申报表以及REITs的SEC文件等多源行政记录，追溯最终所有者并构建全规模分布的投资组合。应用于11个大型核心统计区（CBSA）。
AI.findings: 个人房东拥有绝大多数租赁单元，但其市场份额在不同市场间存在显著差异；广泛使用的邮寄地址聚合方法会系统性地高估或低估投资组合规模。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种可扩展至全国范围的所有权追溯方法，修正了传统测量偏差，为理解租房市场所有权集中度和房东身份提供了新的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和研究者提供了更准确的租赁市场所有权测量工具，有助于理解住房市场结构、监管设计和资源配置。

title: The Risk-free Rate and the Risk-adjusted Growth Rate
affiliations: University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) - Finance Area

detail.title: The Risk-free Rate and the Risk-adjusted Growth Rate
detail.abstract:
Several important questions — such as the possibility of debt-rollover without primary surpluses — turn on whether the present value of the aggregate endowment is finite, i.e., whether the economic growth rate under the “risk-neutral” measure, lies below the risk-free rate. It is tempting to argue that the endowment must be finitely valued, since there exist finitely-valued, non-depreciating assets whose cash flows are cointegrated with aggregate output. This paper shows why this argument is incorrect. A remarkable historical episode in which French government bonds were indexed to aggregate growth allows direct measurement of the risk-adjusted growth rate, which is found to exceed the risk-free rate.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文通过法国政府发行的与经济增长挂钩的债券这一历史自然实验，直接测度了风险调整后的经济增长率，发现该增长率超过了无风险利率。这一发现推翻了“总禀赋现值必然有限”的传统观点，即不能仅凭存在与总产出协整的有限价值非折旧资产来论证现值有限性，因此债务滚雪球（无需基本盈余）在理论上是可能的。
AI.research_question: 总禀赋的现值是否有限？风险中性测度下的经济增长率是否低于无风险利率？
AI.motivation: 债务滚雪球（无需基本盈余即可滚动债务）等关键问题取决于总禀赋现值是否有限。传统观点认为，由于存在与总产出协整的有限价值非折旧资产，总禀赋现值必然有限。本文试图检验这一逻辑是否成立。
AI.theoretical_framework: 风险中性定价理论；现值模型；经济增长与无风险利率的比较框架。
AI.method: 利用法国政府发行的与经济增长挂钩的指数化债券这一历史自然实验，直接测度风险调整后的经济增长率。
AI.findings: 风险调整后的经济增长率超过了无风险利率，即总禀赋的现值无限，推翻了传统观点。
AI.theory_contributions: 纠正了关于总禀赋现值有限性的传统论证错误；为债务可持续性（无需基本盈余的债务滚动）提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 对主权债务管理、财政政策可持续性评估具有重要政策含义。

title: Startups in Africa
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business, , World Bank, Columbia University - Columbia Business School, Economics and Stanford University

detail.title: Startups in Africa
detail.abstract:
We build new data on startups in Africa to study which types of financing these firms demand, how financing is allocated in practice, and the implications for startup creation and the composition of the sector. We combine a continent-wide founder survey, an incentive-compatible experiment estimating financing preferences, and venture capital (VC) deal records matched to founders’ education and work histories. We find that startups strongly prefer equity over debt, but equity is supplied mainly by foreign investors and flows disproportionately to foreign-connected founders. About 80 percent of VC deals involve a foreign investor, and more than 60 percent of funded founders have studied or worked outside Africa. A simple accounting framework shows that this foreignness reflects three main forces: scarce local equity capital, a thin pool of local entrepreneurs able to access startup finance, and frictions limiting local entrepreneurs’ access to foreign investors. Together, these forces reduce startup creation and tilt the sector toward foreign investors and foreign-connected founders.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构建非洲初创企业的新数据集，研究了这些企业对不同融资类型的需求、融资的实际分配情况，以及这对初创企业创建和行业结构的影响。研究发现，初创企业强烈偏好股权融资而非债务融资，但股权主要由外国投资者提供，并不成比例地流向有海外关联的创始人。约80%的风险投资交易涉及外国投资者，超过60%的获得融资的创始人曾在国外学习或工作。一个简单的会计框架表明，这种"外国性"反映了三个主要因素：本地股权资本稀缺、能够获得初创融资的本土企业家群体薄弱，以及限制本土企业家接触外国投资者的摩擦。这些因素共同减少了初创企业的创建，并使该行业偏向外国投资者和海外关联创始人。
AI.research_question: 非洲初创企业需要什么类型的融资？融资在实践中如何分配？这对初创企业创建和行业结构有何影响？
AI.motivation: 非洲初创企业面临融资困境，但以往缺乏系统的数据来理解哪些企业获得了融资、融资类型以及其原因和后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 融资偏好理论（股权vs债务）、资本供给与需求框架、跨境资本流动与企业家网络理论
AI.method: 结合三种数据来源：（1）覆盖全非洲的创始人调查；（2）激励相容的实验以估计融资偏好；（3）风险投资（VC）交易记录与创始人教育及工作经历匹配。并构建简单的会计框架进行量化分析。
AI.findings: （1）初创企业强烈偏好股权融资而非债务融资；（2）股权主要由外国投资者提供，且不成比例地流向有海外经历的创始人；（3）约80%的VC交易涉及外国投资者，超过60%的获得融资的创始人曾在国外学习或工作；（4）三大因素——本地股权资本稀缺、本土企业家融资能力薄弱、本土企业与外国投资者之间的摩擦——共同减少了初创企业创建，并导致行业偏向外国投资者和海外关联创始人。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了新兴市场（非洲）初创企业融资的独特结构特征，提出了"外国性"（foreignness）的概念框架来解释资本供给与需求之间的错配，拓展了发展金融学和创业融资理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供实证依据，表明需要增加本地股权资本供应、降低本土企业家与外国投资者之间的信息摩擦，以促进非洲本土初创企业的发展。

title: How Kenya's Young and Ageing Population Impacts Tax Revenue
affiliations: University of Eldoret, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Northwestern Polytechnical University and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: How Kenya's Young and Ageing Population Impacts Tax Revenue
detail.abstract: Addressing the evolving landscape of taxation across different demographics is crucial for achieving sustainable development goals by 2030, particularly as Kenya grapples with an annual infrastructure financing gap of approximately $2.1 billion. While there has been substantial research on taxation, studies that explore this issue through the lens of demographic changes-particularly the dynamics between the younger and ageing populations-are limited. Existing research has primarily focused on taxation in isolation, neglecting the demographic implications. Our study seeks to fill this critical gap by examining how the growth of the younger population affects tax revenue in comparison to the impacts of an ageing demographic. This approach introduces a vital perspective to current tax theory by demonstrating how demographic dynamics can significantly influence traditional revenue models in Kenya. This research utilises World Bank data spanning from 1980 to 2024, applying ordinary least squares (OLS) regression to examine the link between demographic shifts and tax revenue, with a specific emphasis on the younger and ageing populations. Our findings reveal that an increase in the ageing population positively contributes to tax revenue, whereas growth in the younger population tends to decrease it. Additionally, we identify migration as a significant factor contributing to a loss of tax revenue in Kenya. To address the challenges posed by shrinking tax bases due to these demographic shifts, we recommend policies aimed at extending working lives, facilitating young people's entry into formal employment, and leveraging skilled migration to boost revenue. These empirical results offer practical insights for policymakers, supporting the implementation of targeted strategies designed to broaden the tax base. By comprehensively addressing these demographic challenges, our study not only fills a crucial gap in the literature but also offers innovative recommendations that are vital for sustainable fiscal policy in Kenya.

AI.tldr: 本文利用1980-2024年世界银行数据，通过OLS回归分析肯尼亚年轻人口与老龄化人口对税收收入的不同影响，发现老龄化人口增加会提升税收，而年轻人口增长则降低税收，并提出延长工作年限、促进青年正式就业和利用技术移民等政策建议。
AI.research_question: 年轻人口增长与老龄化人口对肯尼亚税收收入的影响有何不同？
AI.motivation: 肯尼亚每年面临约21亿美元的基础设施融资缺口，而现有税收研究忽视了人口结构变化（尤其是年轻与老龄化人口动态）对税收的影响，存在研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人口结构变化影响税收收入的理论框架，核心关注不同年龄段人口（年轻 vs. 老龄化）对税基的差异性作用。
AI.method: 使用1980-2024年世界银行数据，采用普通最小二乘法（OLS）回归分析，考察人口结构变化与税收收入之间的关系。
AI.findings: （1）老龄化人口增长正向促进税收收入；（2）年轻人口增长负向影响税收收入；（3）移民是导致肯尼亚税收流失的重要因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 将人口统计学视角引入税收理论，证明人口结构动态显著影响传统税收收入模型，填补了税收研究中人口结构维度的空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供实证依据，建议通过延长工作年限、促进青年正式就业、利用技术移民来拓宽税基，实现可持续财政政策。

title: How Much and How Fast Do Investors Respond to Equity Premium Changes? Evidence from Wealth Taxation
affiliations: BI Norwegian Business School, Einaudi Institute for Economics and Finance (EIEF) and University of Texas at Austin - Department of Finance

detail.title: How Much and How Fast Do Investors Respond to Equity Premium Changes? Evidence from Wealth Taxation
detail.abstract:
Using administrative panel data on Norwegian investors’ portfolios, we document strong but slow portfolio allocation responses to a persistent wealth-tax-induced shock to the equity premium. Short-run responses resemble the modest sensitivity documented using surveys. The longer-run responses are much larger and can be rationalized by moderate risk aversion. We document that equity premium shocks affect stock market entry but not exits, suggesting that entry costs dominate participation costs. Our finding of slow responses supports the asset-pricing literature that uses adjustment frictions to explain important asset-pricing puzzles, and has implications for optimal capital taxation when tax rates differ across assets.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 利用挪威投资者投资组合的行政面板数据，本文记录了投资者对持续性财富税引发的股权溢价冲击表现出强烈但缓慢的投资组合配置反应。短期反应与调查中显示的温和敏感性一致，而长期反应则大得多，可以用适度风险厌恶来解释。股权溢价冲击影响股市进入但不影响退出，表明进入成本主导参与成本。反应缓慢的发现支持了使用调整摩擦解释重要资产定价谜题的文献，并对跨资产税率差异下的最优资本税收具有启示意义。
AI.research_question: 投资者对持续性财富税引发的股权溢价冲击如何调整其投资组合配置？短期与长期反应有何差异？
AI.motivation: 现有文献对股权溢价与投资组合配置关系的估计主要依赖调查数据，缺乏对长期反应的充分理解；同时资产定价理论中调整摩擦的作用需要实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资产定价理论（调整摩擦解释资产定价谜题）、最优资本税收理论、投资组合选择理论（进入成本与参与成本）
AI.method: 利用挪威投资者投资组合的行政面板数据，以财富税引发的股权溢价冲击作为外生冲击，分析投资者的短期与长期投资组合调整。
AI.findings: 1）短期反应温和，与调查证据一致；2）长期反应显著更大，可用适度风险厌恶合理化；3）股权溢价冲击影响股市进入但不影响退出，说明进入成本主导参与成本；4）调整缓慢支持调整摩擦解释资产定价谜题。
AI.theory_contributions: 为调整摩擦在资产定价中的作用提供实证证据，区分进入成本与参与成本对投资组合调整的不同影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 对跨资产税率差异下的最优资本税收政策设计具有直接启示意义。

title: How Efficient was the Affordable Care Act at Reducing Uninsured Rates?
affiliations: Loyola University of Chicago - Department of Economics and University of Chicago - Harris School of Public Policy, National Bureau of Economic Research (NBER)

detail.title: How Efficient was the Affordable Care Act at Reducing Uninsured Rates?
detail.abstract:
One way to measure the efficiency of the Affordable Care Act (ACA) is the extent to which gains in publicly supported health insurance reduced uninsured rates. Using data from the 2008–2024 American Community Survey, we examine time trends in rates of uninsured, public insurance coverage, and employer-sponsored insurance (ESI) by groups defined by the ratio of income to the Federal Poverty Line (FPL). We obtain estimates of associations between changes in public coverage and changes in uninsured and ESI exploiting state-by-year variation in ACA implementation. Importantly, we estimate the total effect of the ACA—including both the Medicaid expansion and Marketplace coverage—on uninsured and ESI rates. For adults in households below 150% of the federal poverty level (FPL), increases in public insurance coverage were associated with one-for-one decrease in uninsured and no change in ESI. For adults with incomes between 151%–400% FPL, each percentage point increase in public coverage was associated with about a 0.6 percentage point decrease in uninsured and a 0.4 decrease, or crowd out, in ESI. Crowd-out was larger among groups with higher pre-ACA ESI rates such as parents and married adults. Using variation from the Medicaid expansion alone to evaluate the ACA’s effect on ESI leads to overstating crowd-out among low-income adults (below 150% FPL) and understating crowd-out among higher-income adults (above 250% FPL). Our findings suggest that policies intended to subsidize health insurance of higher income groups, for example, the enhanced premium subsidies, are far less efficient than policies intended to further expand public insurance to low-income groups, for example, in non-expansion states.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 通过分析2008-2024年美国社区调查数据，本文评估了《平价医疗法案》（ACA）对无保险率、公共保险覆盖和雇主赞助保险（ESI）的影响。研究发现：对低收入群体（低于150%联邦贫困线），公共保险增长带来无保险率一对一降低，无挤出效应；对中高收入群体（151%-400%联邦贫困线），公共保险增长存在显著的挤出效应（每增长1个百分点，ESI下降0.4个百分点）。仅用Medicaid扩张评估ACA会高估低收入的挤出、低估高收入的挤出。
AI.research_question: ACA（包括Medicaid扩张和市场保险）对无保险率、公共保险覆盖率和雇主赞助保险（ESI）的总体效应是什么？尤其关注不同收入群体的挤出效应（crowd-out）。
AI.motivation: 准确评估ACA的整体效率，区分Medicaid扩张与市场补贴对不同收入群体的影响差异，纠正仅用Medicaid扩张评估ACA可能带来的偏差，为政策优化提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公共保险对私人保险的"挤出效应"理论、保险覆盖率变化的分解框架。
AI.method: 利用2008-2024年美国社区调查（ACS）数据，基于州-年层面的ACA实施差异，估计公共保险变化与无保险率及ESI变化之间的关联。
AI.findings: 1. 低于150%FPL群体：公共保险每增1个百分点，无保险率降1个百分点，ESI不变（无挤出）。2. 151%-400%FPL群体：公共保险每增1个百分点，无保险率降0.6个百分点，ESI降0.4个百分点（存在挤出）。3. 父母和已婚成人挤出效应更大。4. 仅用Medicaid扩张评估ACA会高估低收入群体挤出，低估高收入群体挤出。
AI.theory_contributions: 细化了ACA在不同收入水平下的挤出效应异质性，揭示了仅用单一政策（Medicaid扩张）评估ACA整体效应的方法论偏差。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供证据：针对低收入群体的公共保险扩展效率更高（无挤出），而对中高收入群体的保费补贴效率较低（存在显著挤出），建议优先在非扩张州推进Medicaid扩张。

title: The Missing Value of Data
affiliations: , University of Pennsylvania - Department of Economics and Columbia University - Columbia Business School

detail.title: The Missing Value of Data
detail.abstract:
Data assets are increasingly vital in modern economies, yet macroeconomic measurement is not well-adapted to capturing their value. Part of the problem is that data is an intangible asset: investments in data are missed in national accounts, and depreciation losses are missed in firms’ balance sheets. Another part, unique to data, is that it serves as a means of payment in the modern economy: consumption bartered for data is also omitted from national accounts. We propose an output-based approach to measure the missing value of data. We treat data as an asset, measure its volume based on the quality of firms’ revenue forecasts, and endogenously determine its depreciation. We then capitalize the data value and explore what the measured GDP would be if the data were treated and transacted similarly to a physical asset. Our findings suggest that the aggregate value of data is about 1.5% of GDP.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于产出的方法来衡量数据资产的价值，发现数据资产总值约占GDP的1.5%。
AI.research_question: 如何衡量宏观经济中数据资产被遗漏的价值？
AI.motivation: 数据资产在现代经济中日益重要，但宏观经济计量（如国民账户和企业资产负债表）未能充分捕捉其价值，且数据作为支付手段（以消费换取数据）也未被纳入核算。
AI.theoretical_framework: 将数据视为一种无形资产，采用基于产出的方法，通过企业收入预测的质量来度量数据量，并内生决定其折旧。
AI.method: 提出基于产出的测量方法：将数据视为资产，基于企业收入预测质量度量数据量，内生确定折旧率，进而资本化数据价值，并与实物资产的处理方式进行比较。
AI.findings: 数据资产的总价值约占GDP的1.5%。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了一种新的基于产出的数据资产测量方法；2. 将数据作为支付手段（易货消费）纳入分析框架；3. 内生化了数据折旧的确定方式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国民账户核算、企业资产负债表调整以及宏观经济政策制定提供了数据资产价值测量的可操作方法。

title: Where There’s Smoke: Stochastic Caregiving Shocks and Mothers’ Labor Market Outcomes
affiliations: School of Global Policy and Strategy and MIT

detail.title: Where There’s Smoke: Stochastic Caregiving Shocks and Mothers’ Labor Market Outcomes
detail.abstract:
Formal childcare and public schooling are widely understood to be central to mothers’ labor market attachment. Yet, a large literature finds that even substantial expansions of formal childcare produce modest or null effects on maternal employment. We study the role of stochastic caregiving demand shocks that cause childcare constraints to bind intermittently even when formal care is available. Using plausibly exogenous variation in wildfire smoke exposure, we show that smoke increases school closures and student absenteeism, generating caregiving demand. Further, by comparing mothers whose youngest child varies in reliance on school-based childcare, we find that these shocks impose substantial contemporaneous costs and, when accumulated, reduce employment. Employment losses are fully offset among mothers working outside male-dominated industries, consistent with workplace tolerance moderating the consequences of intermittent caregiving demands.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了间歇性照护需求冲击（以野火烟雾导致的学校关闭和缺勤为例）如何影响母亲劳动力市场表现，发现即使有正式儿童照护资源，这类冲击仍会通过累积效应降低母亲就业率，且男性主导行业中的母亲受影响更大。
AI.research_question: 在正式儿童照护资源可及的情况下，间歇性照护需求冲击如何影响母亲的劳动力市场依附（就业）？
AI.motivation: 已有大量文献发现，即使大幅扩展正式儿童照护服务，对母亲就业的促进效果仍然有限甚至为零。作者试图解释这一悖论，提出"间歇性照护约束"假说：即使有正式照护，照护需求的随机冲击（如学校关闭）仍会间歇性地束缚母亲的劳动力供给。
AI.theoretical_framework: 间歇性照护需求冲击理论、工作场所容忍度理论（行业性别构成调节效应）
AI.method: 利用野火烟雾暴露作为准外生变量，通过学校关闭和学生缺勤数据衡量照护需求冲击，并比较最小孩子对学校照护依赖程度不同的母亲群体。
AI.findings: 1. 野火烟雾增加学校关闭和学生缺勤，产生照护需求；2. 这类冲击对母亲就业产生显著的同期成本；3. 累积效应会降低母亲就业率；4. 在非男性主导行业工作的母亲，其就业损失被完全抵消，说明工作场所的容忍度（灵活性）是调节因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"间歇性照护约束"理论，解释了为何正式照护扩展对母亲就业效果有限；识别了工作场所容忍度（行业性别构成）作为调节机制，丰富了劳动力市场性别差异的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了新视角：除了增加正式照护供给，还需关注照护需求的随机波动（如学校应急关闭），并建议通过提高工作场所灵活性（尤其对女性集中行业）来缓解母亲就业障碍。

title: Leakage-Safe Financial News Sentiment Trading in United States Equities
affiliations: and University of Birmingham

detail.title: Leakage-Safe Financial News Sentiment Trading in United States Equities

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflicts of interest, financial or personal, that could be perceived to have influenced this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable: this study uses only publicly available market data and news articles and does not involve human participants or personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Financial-news sentiment is widely used as a candidate input to trading and risk-management systems, but classification fidelity need not imply economic value. Using 84,439 news articles for 33 United States equities, we evaluate a leakage-safe pipeline that distils FinBERT weak labels into a RATAT student and converts out-of-fold article probabilities into daily trading features. The student reaches 72.9% teacher accuracy, yet ridge long-only backtests show mean ∆Sharpe =-0.039 relative to a technical baseline across five seeds. Coveragematched teacher tests, XGBoost checks, and a news-volume baseline indicate that coverage, aggregation, and seed stability matter as much as label agreement. The results frame sentiment models as financial-engineering decision aids that require timing-safe, risk-adjusted validation before deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文验证了金融新闻情绪分类的高保真度并不必然转化为交易策略的经济价值。通过FinBERT弱标签蒸馏为RATAT学生模型，虽达72.9%教师准确率，但回测显示相对技术基准平均∆Sharpe=-0.039，表明覆盖度、聚合方式和种子稳定性与标签一致性同等重要。
AI.research_question: 金融新闻情感分类的高保真度是否必然带来交易策略的经济价值？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注情感分类准确率，但忽略了分类性能与交易经济价值之间的脱节，缺乏对情感模型在风险调整后实际贡献的严格验证。
AI.theoretical_framework: 弱监督学习（FinBERT弱标签蒸馏）、知识蒸馏（RATAT学生模型）、风险管理中的夏普比率评估框架、信息覆盖度与聚合理论。
AI.method: 使用84,439篇新闻文章覆盖33只美国股票，构建无泄漏管道：FinBERT生成弱标签→蒸馏为RATAT学生模型→将出折文章概率转换为日度交易特征→进行岭回归多头回测。设置覆盖度匹配的教师测试、XGBoost检验和新闻量基线进行对比。
AI.findings: 学生模型达72.9%教师准确率，但五个种子的岭回归多头回测显示相对技术基准平均∆Sharpe=-0.039；覆盖度、聚合方式和种子稳定性对经济价值的影响与标签一致性相当。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了情感分类模型的"准确性-经济价值缺口"，提出了情感模型应被视为金融工程决策辅助工具而非直接价值创造工具的理论观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融从业者提供了情感模型部署前的风险调整验证框架，强调时序安全、覆盖度匹配和种子稳定性等实际工程考量。

title: Early-Onset Colorectal Cancer in Africa: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Proportion, Incidence, Risk Factors, and Screening Implications
affiliations: Addis Ababa University and Addis Ababa University

detail.title: Early-Onset Colorectal Cancer in Africa: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Proportion, Incidence, Risk Factors, and Screening Implications

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no competing interests.
declarations.funderStatement: None declared.

detail.abstract:
Background: Early-onset colorectal cancer (EOCRC) is rising globally, but Africa’s burden is poorly characterized. We synthesized evidence on EOCRC proportion, incidence, risk factors, and screening implications in Africa.

Methods: In this systematic review and meta-analysis (PROSPERO CRD42024512345), we searched six databases (PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, Embase, the African Index Medicus, and the African Cancer Registry Network (AFCRN)) (2000–2025). We included observational studies reporting CRC cases in African populations with age-stratified data (<40 and/or <50 years). Pooled proportions used random-effects meta-analysis (Freeman–Tukey transformation). Heterogeneity (I2), meta-regression, publication bias (Egger’s test, trim-and-fill), and GRADE certainty were assessed.

Findings: 68 studies (44 for <40 yr, n=21,886; 41 for <50 yr, n=15,578) were included. Pooled EOCRC proportion was 21% (95% CI 18–25; I2=97.4%) for <40 years and 38% (35–41; I2=94.9%) for <50 years. Central Africa had the highest proportion (28% <40 yr). Modifiable risk factors included red meat (OR 1.89), tobacco (1.67), and alcohol (1.58). Advanced stage (III/IV) occurred in 67%; 5-year survival was 38%. Publication bias for <40 yr (Egger’s p=0.007) was adjusted to 18% (14–22%). GRADE certainty: moderate for primary outcomes.

Interpretation: One in five African CRC cases are diagnosed before age 40 proportions two to threefold higher than in Western settings. Urgent re-evaluation of CRC screening is needed. We propose faecal immunochemical testing (FIT) based screening from age 40 in Sub-Saharan Africa, with risk stratification.

AI.tldr: 本文通过系统综述和荟萃分析，发现非洲早发性结直肠癌（EOCRC）比例显著高于西方国家：21%确诊于40岁前，38%确诊于50岁前；中央非洲比例最高（28%）。主要可改变风险因素包括红肉（OR 1.89）、烟草（1.67）和酒精（1.58）。研究建议撒哈拉以南非洲从40岁起开展基于FIT的筛查。
AI.research_question: 非洲早发性结直肠癌（EOCRC）的比例、发病率、风险因素及筛查启示是什么？
AI.motivation: 全球早发性结直肠癌发病率持续上升，但非洲地区的疾病负担尚缺乏系统描述，亟需整合现有证据以指导公共卫生决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于系统综述和荟萃分析的方法学框架，采用随机效应模型（Freeman–Tukey转换）进行比例合并，利用I²统计量评估异质性，通过meta回归探索异质性来源，并使用Egger检验和剪补法评估发表偏倚。
AI.method: 系统综述与荟萃分析（PROSPERO注册号CRD42024512345），检索六大数据库（2000–2025年），纳入报告非洲人群结直肠癌病例且包含年龄分层数据（<40岁和/或<50岁）的观察性研究，最终纳入68项研究。
AI.findings: 1）40岁以下EOCRC合并比例为21%（95% CI 18–25%），50岁以下为38%（35–41%）；2）中央非洲40岁以下比例最高（28%）；3）风险因素：红肉（OR 1.89）、烟草（1.67）、酒精（1.58）；4）67%患者确诊时为晚期（III/IV期），5年生存率仅38%；5）存在发表偏倚，校正后40岁以下比例为18%。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统量化非洲早发性结直肠癌的疾病负担，揭示其比例是西方国家的2–3倍，填补了非洲EOCRC流行病学证据空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出撒哈拉以南非洲应从40岁起开展基于粪便免疫化学检测（FIT）的风险分层筛查，为非洲结直肠癌筛查指南的重新制定提供了关键循证依据。

title: The Mandated Revelation Field and a Conserved-State Measure of Scheduled Disclosure in U.S. Equity Markets

detail.title: The Mandated Revelation Field and a Conserved-State Measure of Scheduled Disclosure in U.S. Equity Markets

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests, financial relationships, or other conflicts of interest relevant to this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses only publicly available, de-identified regulatory filings and market data obtained from the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission EDGAR system and public price feeds. No human subjects, patients, or participants were involved. No ethics approval or informed consent is required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no funding. The author is an independent researcher with no institutional affiliation and no external financial support. All data used are freely available from public sources (EDGAR, Yahoo Finance).

detail.abstract: We define the Mandated Revelation Field, a conserved, dated inventory of economic facts that are already legally true but not yet public, and show that the aggregate cross-statute schedule of legally forced future self-revelation is a measurable market-state object distinct from holdings, flows, and price impact. The object cleaves into an exact layer, whose timing and existence are computed deterministically from public regulatory rules, and a magnitude layer, reported as Manski partialidentification bounds rather than point estimates. We construct the reference implementation entirely on free public data: a time-versioned, cryptographically hashed lattice of eleven rule branches across four statute families, an EDGAR ingest of 1,132 content-addressed filings, and a dated owed-fact ledger of 2,583 facts whose canonical hash is byte-identical across clean rebuilds. Four integrity gates, determinism, conservation, identification, and provenance, are enforced as part of a 94-test suite and are green on a two-year backtest. The conservation identity holds at all 428 evaluation dates, and a deliberately corrupted input correctly turns the gate red. We validate the magnitude bounds on real data: the participation-bounded second-order-cone interval contains the true reported transaction value for 1,535 of 1,536 Form 4 facts, a 99.9 percent containment rate. We then exploit the February 5, 2024 Schedule 13D deadline change, from ten calendar days to five business days, as a natural experiment on disclosure timing, with Schedule 13G filers as an untreated control. The pre-registered differencein-differences finds that the rule moved the compliance share within five business days (plus 0.35, p = 0.007) but not the mean lag, the bid-ask spread, or the adverse-selection-proxy illiquidity, an honest mixed finding. On a powered, pre-registered flagship test across 374 securities and 8,976 observations, the raw surfacing density does not beat a calendar null out of sample (t = 0.40), so under the locked decision rule the return-prediction claim is dead, reported verbatim, while the orthogonalized crossstatute component remains incrementally significant beyond the single-statute 13F control (t = 3.09, p = 0.002, surviving false-discovery-rate control). We are explicit about what is novel: the conserved cross-statute aggregation and its deterministic drain calendar, not the existence of date-localized abnormal returns, which is already established.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个名为“强制披露域”（Mandated Revelation Field）的跨法规经济事实数据库，通过确定性规则和概率边界双重结构，系统性地量化了已合法存在但尚未公开的经济信息的聚合特征，并利用自然实验和预注册检验验证了其市场影响与预测能力。
AI.research_question: 跨法规强制披露的时间安排是否构成一个可测量的市场状态对象？该对象的聚合密度是否能预测未来收益？
AI.motivation: 现有文献多关注单一法规（如13F）的披露效应，但缺乏跨法规、跨时间的经济事实聚合框架。作者希望构造一个保守的、确定性的披露时间日历，并检验其市场信息含量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 强制披露域理论（Mandated Revelation Field）、Manski部分识别边界、差分差分法（DiD）、预注册假设检验、假发现率控制（FDR）。
AI.method: 基于公开监管规则构建确定性披露日历（精确层），结合EDGAR数据构建2,583个事实的债务事实分类账（幅度层），应用Manski部分识别边界而非点估计，通过94项测试套件确保完整性（确定性、守恒性、识别性、可溯源性），利用2024年2月5日Schedule 13D截止日变更作为自然实验，进行预注册的差分差分分析。
AI.findings: （1）守恒性在所有428个评估日期成立；（2）幅度层在1,536个Form 4事实中达到99.9%的包含率；（3）自然实验表明截止日变更提高了5个工作日内合规比例（+0.35, p=0.007），但未改变平均滞后、价差或逆向选择代理流动性指标；（4）原始披露密度未能超越日历零假设预测收益率（t=0.40），但正交化的跨法规成分在13F控制之外仍显著（t=3.09, p=0.002）。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出“强制披露域”这一跨法规聚合市场状态对象，区分确定性披露日历（精确层）与部分识别边界（幅度层），揭示披露密度的时间安排而非是否存在局部异常收益才是真正的创新点。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个完全基于免费公开数据、可复现的参考实现，包含94项完整性测试，可作为监管者评估披露规则变化影响的工具，并为交易者提供跨法规信息披露时间安排的度量框架。

reference: KIEP Research Paper, Apec Study Series (APEC), 25-02
title: ESG, Economy, and Fertility: A Machine Learning Analysis of APEC Economy
affiliations: Konkuk University and Hongik University

detail.title: ESG, Economy, and Fertility: A Machine Learning Analysis of APEC Economy

publicationDetails.detailsText: KIEP Research Paper, Apec Study Series (APEC), 25-02
publicationDetails.journalName: Korea Institute for International Economic Policy (KIEP) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper investigates how environmental, social, and governance (ESG) conditions, together with economic factors, shape fertility dynamics in APEC economies. Using World Development Indicators from 1996 to 2021 and assembling more than 1,400 indicators, we predict annual changes in the crude birth rate. Models are trained on non-APEC economies and tested out of sample on APEC economies. Random Forest achieves the lowest RMSE at 0.397, and models that combine ESG and economic variables outperform those relying on economic indicators alone, with RMSE values of 0.271 and 0.298 respectively. SHapley Additive Explanations (SHAP) reveal that environmental factors are the most influential predictors of fertility in APEC, followed by governance, while social factors are smaller in magnitude but show increasing importance over time. Lag analysis indicates short-run effects for social and governance variables at one-year lags and medium-term cumulative effects for environmental variables, peaking around four years. Country-level profiles highlight clear heterogeneity: environmental drivers dominate in China and Russia, governance factors are most important in Korea and the United States, and social influences are stronger in Canada and Japan. The study provides a comprehensive, externally validated, and interpretable framework for fertility prediction, while emphasizing that the analysis remains predictive and associational rather than causal. We regard this as a first step toward more rigorous causal evaluation of the highlighted drivers.

AI.tldr: 本文利用1996-2021年APEC经济体数据，结合ESG与经济指标，通过随机森林等机器学习模型预测粗出生率变化，发现环境因素对生育率影响最大，治理次之，社会因素虽小但重要性随时间上升。模型在非APEC数据上训练并外推验证，为非因果性的生育率预测提供了可解释框架。
AI.research_question: 环境、社会和治理（ESG）条件如何与经济因素共同影响APEC经济体的生育率动态？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注经济因素对生育率的影响，较少系统考察ESG因素的作用；且缺乏跨经济体、可解释的预测框架。本研究旨在填补这一空白，提供一个综合且可解释的生育率预测模型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合ESG框架（环境、社会、治理）与传统经济因素，利用机器学习（随机森林）进行预测，并运用SHAP方法解释各因素的贡献度。
AI.method: 使用1996-2021年世界发展指标，收集超过1400个指标；在非APEC经济体上训练模型，在APEC经济体上做样本外测试；采用随机森林等模型，以RMSE评估性能，并用SHAP进行特征重要性解释。
AI.findings: 1. 结合ESG与经济变量的模型优于仅用经济指标（RMSE: 0.271 vs 0.298）。2. 随机森林表现最佳（RMSE: 0.397）。3. SHAP显示环境因素影响最大，治理次之，社会因素较小但重要性随时间上升。4. 社会与治理变量存在一年滞后效应，环境变量存在四年左右的累积效应。5. 国家间异质性明显：中国和俄罗斯以环境因素主导，韩国和美国以治理因素为主，加拿大和日本社会因素更强。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统地将ESG框架引入生育率预测研究。2. 利用机器学习方法提供了可解释的预测框架，揭示了ESG各维度对不同经济体生育率的差异化影响。3. 通过滞后分析揭示了ESG因素的时间动态效应，拓展了对生育率驱动因素时间维度的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为APEC经济体政策制定者提供了基于ESG视角的生育率预测工具。2. 揭示了不同国家/地区生育率的主要驱动因素差异，有助于制定针对性政策。3. 强调分析的预测性和关联性而非因果性，为后续因果研究提供了基础。

detail.title: From Live to Recording: Consumer Demand and Response to Price Across the Livestreaming Lifecycle

contentType.other: This paper was recently accepted by Marketing Science and is currently awaiting online publication. It was previously inactivated on SSRN, and I would like to request that its status be changed to Publicly Available.

publicationDetails.detailsText:
Accepted for publication in Marketing Science.

A previous version of this paper was circulated under the title "The Role of 'Live' in Livestreaming Markets: Evidence Using Orthogonal Random Forest."

detail.abstract: Livestreaming has evolved into a thriving industry where creators can directly monetize and engage with their audiences and followers. In practice, creators and platforms typically concentrate their marketing efforts on the period leading up to the livestream. However, livestreaming events naturally transition into recorded formats once the event concludes, creating potential "residual" opportunities for monetization. This study systematically examines consumer demand for live events throughout the entire livestream life-cycle, using data from a large livestreaming platform that allows consumers to purchase the recorded version of a paid live event after the livestream ends. We find that the demand is surprisingly more price-sensitive during the pre-livestream period compared to the post-period. This is partly driven by two mechanisms: consumer self-selection (infrequent consumers who may have missed the live events exhibit a higher willingness to pay for recorded versions) and quality uncertainty (consumers face higher uncertainty in event quality during the pre-period than in the post-period). Our findings generate implications for the pricing and targeting strategies in livestreaming markets.

AI.tldr: 本文研究直播内容在直播前（预售）和直播后（录播）两个阶段的需求差异，发现直播前的需求反而比直播后对价格更敏感，原因包括消费者自选择和产品质量不确定性。
AI.research_question: 直播内容在直播前（预售）和直播后（录播）两个阶段，消费者需求的价格敏感性是否存在差异？其背后的机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 直播已成为重要经济形态，但业内通常只重视直播前的营销，忽略了直播结束后录播版本的"残余"变现机会。现有文献缺乏对直播全生命周期消费者需求的系统性研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 消费者自选择理论、质量不确定性理论、价格敏感性理论
AI.method: 基于某大型直播平台的真实交易数据，对比分析直播前与直播后两个阶段消费者对同一付费直播内容的需求及价格敏感性差异。
AI.findings: 直播前的需求比直播后对价格更敏感，这一现象由两个机制驱动：(1) 消费者自选择——不常观看直播的消费者因错过直播而对录播版本有更高支付意愿；(2) 质量不确定性——直播前消费者对内容质量的不确定性高于直播后。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统研究直播内容的跨生命周期需求差异，揭示了直播前与直播后价格敏感性的反向关系，拓展了动态定价与消费者行为理论在直播场景中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为直播平台和创作者提供定价与目标用户定位策略建议，提示应重视直播后的录播变现机会，并区分不同阶段消费者的差异化定价策略。

title: Relaxing the Constraints: Working from Home and Labour Supply Preferences
affiliations: German Institute for Economic Research (DIW Berlin) - German Socio Economic Panel, University of Surrey and University of Surrey

detail.title: Relaxing the Constraints: Working from Home and Labour Supply Preferences
detail.abstract: Working from home (WFH) has expanded persistently since the COVID-19 pandemic, yet whether it relaxes labour-supply constraints or instead intensifies work remains unclear. We study this question using the 2023 wave of the German SocioEconomic Panel (SOEP), which uniquely records both realised and desired working hours in the post-pandemic period, and instrumenting realised WFH with prepandemic occupational WFH feasibility. We find that WFH increases both realised and desired labour supply for women, while for men it raises realised hours but leaves desired hours unaffected. The gender divergence points to distinct mechanisms. For women, the increase in desired hours is consistent with WFH relaxing time-coordination constraints between market work and home production. For men, the rise in realised hours without a corresponding increase in desired hours is more consistent with work intensification. Our findings suggest that remote work converts previously unrealised labour supply preferences into realised hours among workers constrained by household responsibilities, with important implications for gender equality and labour shortages in ageing economies.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2023年德国SOEP数据，发现居家办公（WFH）对男性和女性的劳动供给产生不同影响：女性在WFH下实际和期望工时均增加，表明WFH缓解了家务协调约束；男性实际工时增加但期望工时不变，更符合工作强化效应。这揭示了WFH对不同性别的差异化机制及其对性别平等和劳动力短缺的影响。
AI.research_question: 居家办公（WFH）是缓解劳动力供给约束，还是反而加剧了工作强度？其对不同性别的影响机制有何差异？
AI.motivation: 疫情后居家办公持续扩张，但其对劳动供给的影响方向尚不明确（缓解约束 vs. 工作强化），且可能存在性别异质性，这对理解劳动力市场、性别平等及老龄化经济体的劳动力短缺问题具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 时间协调约束理论（家务与市场工作的时间分配）；2) 工作强化理论（WFH导致工作边界模糊、工时增加）
AI.method: 使用2023年德国社会经济面板（SOEP）数据，以疫情前职业的WFH可行性作为工具变量，估计WFH对实际工时和期望工时的影响。
AI.findings: 1) 对女性：WFH同时提高了实际工时和期望工时，支持"放松时间协调约束"机制；2) 对男性：WFH提高了实际工时，但期望工时未增加，支持"工作强化"机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 区分了WFH影响劳动供给的两种机制（缓解约束 vs. 工作强化），并揭示了二者在性别维度上的差异化体现，丰富了远程工作与劳动供给的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解WFH对性别平等的影响提供实证依据：WFH有助于将受家务约束的女性潜在劳动供给转化为实际工时；同时提示需关注男性在WFH下面临的工作强化风险。对老龄化经济体制定缓解劳动力短缺的政策具有参考价值。

title: Risk Transmission and Dynamic Evolution from International Commodity Markets to China's Industrial Chain: A Multi-Layer Network Perspective
affiliations: Nanning University, Guangxi University of Finance and Economics, Guangdong Academy of Social Sciences and Nanning University

detail.title: Risk Transmission and Dynamic Evolution from International Commodity Markets to China's Industrial Chain: A Multi-Layer Network Perspective

declarations.funderStatement: National Social Science Fund Western Project (Grant No. 24XJY047); “Empowerment” Action Plan – Guangxi Key R&D Program (Contract No. FN2600640016, Establishment No. 2025FNFN96350); National Natural Science Foundation of China Regional Science Fund (Grant No. 72462001); Guangxi Philosophy and Social Sciences Project (Grant No. 23FYJ026).

keywords: risk spillover; commodities; industrial chain transmission; DCC-GARCH; LASSO-VAR-DY; Granger causality

detail.abstract: International commodity price fluctuations transmit to China's real economy through complex multi-layer network channels, yet the transmission pathways and dynamic evolution characteristics thereof have not been systematically characterized within a unified framework. This study constructs a three-layer risk spillover network comprising international commodity markets (L1, 8 varieties), China's commodity futures market (L2, 25 varieties), and the real industrial chain (L3, 8 sector indices). Methodologically, we employ the DCC-GARCH(1,1) model to capture dynamic conditional correlations within the international commodity layer, the LASSO-VAR-DY spillover index framework to quantify intra-and inter-layer risk spillover intensities in China's futures market, and input-output heuristics together with rolling correlations to establish commodity-industry inter-layer linkages. Analytically, we integrate Granger causality tests, Louvain community detection, and Bai-Perron multiple structural break tests. Empirical analysis yields five principal findings. (1) The total risk spillover index of China's commodity futures market reaches 58.68%, meaning that approximately three-fifths of forecast error variance is attributable to cross-variety spillover effects. Energy-chemical products occupy the core transmission positions in the network: polypropylene (PP) and methanol are the top two net risk transmitters (NET = +0.2842 and +0.2415), whereas consumer agricultural products such as live hog and red dates are the primary net receivers. (2) Granger causality tests identify 39 significant causal pairs (p < 0.05); cotton, corn, and iron ore each Granger-cause three other varieties, reflecting the price leadership of upstream raw materials. (3) Louvain community detection partitions the L2 layer into two functional communities-a consumption-driven community (agricultural products and daily-use chemicals) and a production-investment-driven community (energy-chemicals and ferrous metals)-revealing a pronounced dichotomy within the commodity market. (4) Cross-layer transmission analysis shows that the indirect association between methanol and the steel sector (r = 0.226) exceeds most direct input-output linkages; indirect transmission paths dominate L2-L3 conduction. (5) Dynamic evolution analysis reveals that during the COVID-19 pandemic, the total spillover index surged from approximately 65% to 83% (+28%) and network density rose by 61% (from 0.23 to 0.37); the Russia-Ukraine conflict subsequently triggered an acute intensification of intra-block correlations within energy and agricultural commodity sectors. This study provides a theoretical framework and quantitative toolkit for constructing cross-market risk surveillance and early-warning systems and for managing industrial chain risks, bearing important practical implications for macroprudential regulatory policy design and industrial chain resilience enhancement.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构建三层风险溢出网络（国际市场-中国期货-实体产业链），利用DCC-GARCH、LASSO-VAR-DY等方法，系统刻画了国际大宗商品价格波动向中国实体经济传导的路径与动态演化特征。研究发现：58.68%的风险来自跨品种溢出；能化品种（PP、甲醇）为核心风险输出方；市场呈现消费驱动与生产投资驱动的二元社区结构；间接传导路径主导跨层传递；新冠疫情期间溢出指数从65%飙升至83%，网络密度上升61%。
AI.research_question: 国际大宗商品价格波动如何通过多层网络渠道传导至中国实体经济？传导路径和动态演化特征是什么？
AI.motivation: 现有研究未能在统一框架内系统刻画国际大宗商品价格波动向中国实体经济传导的路径与动态演化特征，缺乏对多层网络渠道的系统性表征。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多层风险溢出网络理论、DCC-GARCH模型、LASSO-VAR-DY溢出指数框架、投入产出启发式方法、Granger因果关系、Louvain社区检测、Bai-Perron多重结构断点检验。
AI.method: 构建三层风险溢出网络（L1国际大宗商品市场、L2中国商品期货市场、L3实体产业链）。采用DCC-GARCH(1,1)捕捉动态条件相关、LASSO-VAR-DY量化溢出强度、投入产出启发式与滚动相关建立跨层连接，综合运用Granger因果检验、Louvain社区检测和Bai-Perron结构断点检验。
AI.findings: (1)总风险溢出指数58.68%，PP和甲醇为最大净风险输出方，活猪和红枣为主要净接收方；(2)39个显著Granger因果对，棉花、玉米、铁矿石各有3个Granger因；(3)Louvain分两个功能社区：消费驱动与生产投资驱动；(4)甲醇与钢铁部门的间接关联超越多数直接投入产出联系；(5)疫情期间溢出指数从65%升至83%，网络密度从0.23升至0.37，俄乌冲突加剧能源和农产品板块内关联。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在统一框架内系统构建了"国际市场-中国期货-实体产业链"三层风险溢出网络，揭示了间接传导路径的主导地位及市场二元社区结构，丰富了跨国商品价格传导与风险溢出理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为构建跨市场风险监测预警系统和管理产业链风险提供了理论框架与量化工具，对宏观审慎监管政策设计和产业链韧性提升具有重要参考价值。

title: Existential Threats and Deterrence: Japan's Legal Pathway to Enhanced Collective Security in Asia
affiliations: Columbia Law School

detail.title: Existential Threats and Deterrence: Japan's Legal Pathway to Enhanced Collective Security in Asia

publicationDetails.detailsText: Columbia Public Law Research Paper Forthcoming
publicationDetails.journalName: Columbia Law School, Public Law & Legal Theory Research Paper Series

publicationDetails.detailsText: American University International Law Review, Vol. 40: Iss. 2

detail.abstract: With the Japanese Cabinet’s decision in December 2022 to comprehensively upgrade Japan’s security posture, and its rapid build-up of its defense capabilities, Japan’s role in Asia’s security architecture has been undergoing a fundamental shift. This article places Japan’s 2015 Peace and Security Legislation in the context of the U.N. collective security system and argues that its most significant achievement has been to expand Japan’s power to engage more proactively in the Asian collective security order. To date, commentators have focused on the legislation’s role in expanding the Japanese constitution’s limitations on the use of force to permit collective self-defense. This article argues that the legislation’s true significance lies in Japan’s strengthened deterrence capabilities resulting from an evolution away from its narrow focus on survival threats as a justification for permissible uses of force (a subject of constitutional interpretation), to broader legal justifications for the use of arms to counter lower order threats (a subject of legislative action). These enhanced capabilities have permitted Japan to undertake initiatives to build a new security architecture in Asia based on a significantly strengthened U.S. alliance and supplemental “minilateral” groupings. However, as deterrence activities grow, the line between “deterrence” and “survival” may start to blur, potentially taking the debates about permitted uses of force in new directions. The separate histories of the U.S. and Japan’s engagement with collective security suggest the directions in which these debates may lead.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了日本2015年和平安全立法如何通过扩展武力使用的法律依据（从宪法层面的存亡威胁到立法层面的低阶威胁），增强其威慑能力，从而推动亚洲安全架构的转变，但指出威慑与存亡界限的模糊可能引发新的法律辩论。
AI.research_question: 日本2015年和平安全立法如何改变其在亚洲集体安全秩序中的角色？其真正的战略意义是什么？
AI.motivation: 现有评论过度聚焦于该立法对宪法集体自卫权解释的放宽，忽视了其更重要的战略影响——通过法律依据的转变增强威慑能力，进而重塑亚洲安全架构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 联合国集体安全体系；威慑理论；宪法解释与立法行动的二元框架；从"存亡威胁"到"低阶威胁"的武力使用合法性谱系。
AI.method: 法律文本分析；历史比较分析（美日集体安全参与史）；案例研究（日本安全政策演变）。
AI.findings: 1) 立法真正的成就是扩大了日本参与亚洲集体安全秩序的能力；2) 关键变化是从宪法层面的"存亡威胁"扩展到立法层面的"低阶威胁"武力使用依据；3) 这增强了日本威慑能力，使其能通过强化美日同盟和"小多边"集团构建新安全架构；4) 但威慑与存亡界限的模糊可能引发新的法律争议。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了分析日本安全政策演变的新框架，区分了宪法解释与立法行动两个层面，揭示了武力使用合法性的渐进扩展路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解日本安全政策转型提供了深度分析，指出了美日历史经验对未来辩论方向的启示，对政策制定者和国际关系学者具有参考价值。

title: Hedging Portfolio Risk in Energy and Commodity Markets: Evidence from DCC-GARCH Connectedness  ​
affiliations: University of Piraeus - Department of Economics, University of Piraeus, National Technical University of Athens (NTUA) and Audencia Business School

detail.title: Hedging Portfolio Risk in Energy and Commodity Markets: Evidence from DCC-GARCH Connectedness  ​
detail.abstract: Amid escalating geopolitical tensions and increasing market volatility, this paper examines the dynamic interlinkages between global energy markets and key agricultural and metal commodities, using a high-frequency DCC-GARCH connectedness framework. Drawing on a rich dataset spanning January 2015 to November 2024, a period punctuated by the COVID-19 pandemic, the Russia–Ukraine war, Middle East instability, and three U.S. elections, we uncover time-varying volatility spillovers and shifting systemic roles across asset classes. We also identify structural asymmetries in how markets respond to geopolitical acts versus threats, with threats generating a persistent risk premium in energy markets. Our findings carry important implications for investors, policymakers, risk managers and energy market participants seeking to understand the volatility transition mechanism, energy market stability and the diversification opportunities which may rise during periods of heightened geopolitical uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本文利用高频率DCC-GARCH关联性框架，研究2015年1月至2024年11月期间全球能源市场与关键农产品及金属商品之间的动态波动溢出效应，发现时变波动溢出、资产类别间系统性角色的转变，以及地缘政治行为与威胁引发的结构性不对称反应。
AI.research_question: 全球能源市场与主要农产品、金属商品之间的动态波动溢出效应如何？地缘政治行为与威胁对市场的影响是否存在结构性不对称？
AI.motivation: 地缘政治紧张局势升级和市场波动加剧的背景下，需要深入理解能源市场与其他大宗商品类别之间的波动传导机制及其对投资组合多样化、市场稳定性的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: DCC-GARCH动态条件相关模型、波动溢出关联性框架、地缘政治风险溢价理论
AI.method: 采用高频率DCC-GARCH关联性框架，基于2015年1月至2024年11月的大样本数据进行实证分析。
AI.findings: （1）存在显著的时变波动溢出效应；（2）不同资产类别的系统性角色随时间推移发生转变；（3）市场对地缘政治行为与威胁存在结构性不对称反应，其中威胁在能源市场中产生持续的风险溢价。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了地缘政治行为与威胁对市场的差异化影响机制，拓展了对波动传导非对称性的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者、政策制定者、风险管理者和能源市场参与者提供了理解波动传导机制、评估能源市场稳定性以及识别地缘政治高度不确定时期多样化机会的实用指导。

title: Does Military Spending Stabilize or Destabilize Governments? International Analysis
affiliations: Illinois State University - Department of Economics and University of Akron - Department of Economics

detail.title: Does Military Spending Stabilize or Destabilize Governments? International Analysis
detail.abstract: Military spending by nations has the potential to either stabilize governments or destabilize them (via threats of coups, for instance). We study this relationship formally by using a rich dataset on more than 150 countries, spanning nearly two recent decades from 2006 to 2023. Among other relevant factors, the analysis pays special attention to the role of corruption. The main results show that both military spending and corruption increase fragility. When three-year intervals are studied over the large time span, the positive effect of corruption remains robust, but the positive effect of military spending loses statistical significance over some periods. In other findings, greater economic prosperity promotes stability, while greater economic uncertainty has the opposite effect. Democratic nations tend to be more stable, but this is not necessarily true of presidential democracies. Furthermore, ethnic fractionalization and genetic distance promote instability, but population density has the reverse effect. Finally, considering the endogeneity of corruption via IV regressions supports the main findings, and the mediation analysis shows little mediation. Policy implications are discussed.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2006-2023年150多个国家的数据，研究军费开支和腐败对国家脆弱性的影响，发现两者均增加国家脆弱性，但军费开支的效应在某些时期不显著；经济繁荣和民主促进稳定，而经济不确定性、种族分化等则加剧不稳定。
AI.research_question: 军费开支和腐败如何影响国家稳定性（脆弱性）？
AI.motivation: 军费开支既可能稳定政府（通过增强国防能力），也可能 destabilize 政府（例如通过政变威胁），但这一关系缺乏系统的实证检验。本研究旨在利用跨国面板数据，特别关注腐败的调节/交互作用，填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国家脆弱性理论、腐败与治理理论、军费开支的政治经济学
AI.method: 使用2006-2023年150多个国家的面板数据，采用固定效应回归、三年间隔分析、工具变量回归（处理腐败的内生性）以及中介分析。
AI.findings: 1）军费开支和腐败均显著增加国家脆弱性；2）腐败的效应在三年间隔分析中始终稳健，而军费开支的效应在某些时期失去统计显著性；3）经济繁荣和民主（但总统制民主除外）促进稳定；4）经济不确定性、种族分化、遗传距离加剧不稳定；5）人口密度增加稳定性；6）工具变量回归支持主结果，中介分析显示中介效应较小。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统检验了军费开支与腐败对国家脆弱性的联合影响，区分了二者效应的稳健性差异，揭示了腐败效应的持续性和军费开支效应的情境依赖性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了实证依据：减少腐败是增强国家稳定的关键，而削减军费开支的稳定效应可能因时期而异；此外，总统制民主政体需要特别关注稳定性风险。

title: The Future of International Security Governance in High-Risk Regions
affiliations: Oxford Academy

detail.title: The Future of International Security Governance in High-Risk Regions

keywords: International Security Governance High-Risk Regions; Security Governance; Global Risk Management; Governance Effectiveness; Adaptive Governance; Institutional Resilience; Human Security; Climate Security; Cybersecurity Governance; Artificial Intelligence Governance; Strategic Foresight; Risk Intelligence; Complex Adaptive Systems; Integrated Future Security Governance Framework (IFSGF); International Security Management; Global Risk Operations; Governance Innovation; Regional Security; Security Policy.

detail.abstract: International security governance is undergoing significant transformation as governments, international organizations, and security institutions confront increasingly complex and interconnected threats. Traditional security governance frameworks, which were largely designed to address state-centric and military-oriented challenges, are facing growing pressure from emerging risks including cyber threats, hybrid warfare, climate change, transnational crime, information operations, public health emergencies, and technological disruption. These developments have created a need for governance approaches that are more adaptive, resilient, collaborative, and capable of managing uncertainty within high-risk regions.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了国际安全治理在应对网络威胁、混合战争、气候变化等新兴复杂风险时所面临的转型压力，指出现有以国家为中心的传统安全框架已不足以应对这些挑战，需要更具适应性、韧性和协作性的治理方法。
AI.research_question: 传统国际安全治理框架如何转型以有效应对日益复杂和相互关联的新兴安全威胁？
AI.motivation: 传统安全治理框架以国家中心和军事导向为主，难以应对网络威胁、混合战争、气候变化、跨国犯罪、公共卫生危机等新兴风险，亟需探索更具适应性和协作性的治理路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际安全治理理论、传统安全与新兴安全框架对比、适应性治理与韧性治理理论。
AI.method: 概念分析/文献综述（基于对国际安全治理现状的定性分析）。
AI.findings: 传统安全治理框架面临来自网络威胁、混合战争、气候变化等多维度新兴风险的巨大压力，需要向更具适应性、韧性、协作性和不确定性管理能力的治理模式转型。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了国际安全治理理论的分析边界，将非传统安全议题（如公共卫生、技术颠覆等）纳入治理框架，丰富了适应性治理和韧性治理在安全领域的理论应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府、国际组织及安全机构提供了安全治理转型的方向性建议，强调构建跨领域协作机制和应对不确定性的治理能力。

title: In Search of Relational Stability: A Global Comparative Analysis of Evidence-Based Parenting Interventions and Judicial Frameworks

detail.title: In Search of Relational Stability: A Global Comparative Analysis of Evidence-Based Parenting Interventions and Judicial Frameworks

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder and principal consultant of a private training and consulting firm specializing in family relationships and organizational development. This research was conducted independently, without any financial support, direction, or influence from the author's business entity. The content of this paper does not promote any commercial products or services, and the author declares no competing financial or non-financial interests that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this manuscript.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human subjects research. It comprises comparative policy and documentary analysis of publicly available legislative frameworks and published program evaluations.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding from any public, commercial, or not-for-profit organizations. All research costs, including literature access, data collection, and manuscript preparation, were personally funded by the author.

detail.abstract: This paper presents a global comparative analysis of evidence-based parenting interventions and judicial frameworks across seven jurisdictions: Sweden, Germany, Singapore, Australia, Iceland, Canada, and Ireland. Drawing on developmental psychology theories-specifically Diana Baumrind's parenting styles typology and John Bowlby's attachment theory-the study examines how legislative reforms, tiered clinical interventions, and community-wide initiatives collectively shift parenting practices toward an authoritative, warm, and structured approach. The analysis identifies five distinct program architectures: universal public health portals, tiered behavioral frameworks, marginalized preventative frameworks, community-wide structural interventions, and systemic communicative programs. Each model is evaluated in terms of its theoretical coherence, governance structure, scope of services, and demonstrated effectiveness in promoting positive developmental outcomes. Findings indicate that the most effective national systems integrate legal protections for children, accessible public information, and targeted behavioral support to promote secure parent-child attachments. These integrated approaches simultaneously address legislative, informational, and clinical dimensions of parenting support, offering a comprehensive framework for policymakers seeking to strengthen family outcomes across diverse socioeconomic and cultural contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文对七个国家（瑞典、德国、新加坡、澳大利亚、冰岛、加拿大、爱尔兰）的循证育儿干预和司法框架进行了全球比较分析，发现最有效的国家系统整合了法律保护、公共信息和针对性行为支持，以促进安全型亲子依恋。
AI.research_question: 不同国家的循证育儿干预与司法框架如何影响育儿实践，以及哪种整合模式对促进积极发展结果最有效？
AI.motivation: 各国在育儿支持体系上存在显著差异，缺乏系统的跨国比较研究来识别最有效的整合模式，以为政策制定提供参考。
AI.theoretical_framework: Diana Baumrind的育儿风格类型学（权威型、专制型、放任型）和John Bowlby的依恋理论。
AI.method: 全球比较分析，对七个国家的育儿干预和司法框架进行系统评估，识别五种不同的项目架构并比较其理论一致性、治理结构、服务范围和有效性。
AI.findings: 识别出五种项目架构：全民公共卫生门户、分层行为框架、边缘化预防框架、社区范围结构干预和系统传播项目。最有效的系统整合了法律保护、公共信息获取和针对性行为支持，同时解决了立法、信息和临床三个维度。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Baumrind的育儿风格类型学和Bowlby的依恋理论应用于跨国政策比较分析，建立了理论框架与政策实践之间的桥梁。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了综合性育儿支持框架，指明了在不同社会经济和文化背景下整合立法、信息和临床干预的最优路径。

title: Random Set Quantile Estimation of Partially Identified Discrete Response Models
affiliations: Boston College,  and University of Virginia

detail.title: Random Set Quantile Estimation of Partially Identified Discrete Response Models
detail.abstract: Semiparametric discrete choice models are widely applied in economics, yet a fundamental tension arises when covariates are discrete as regression coefficients that are point identified under continuous regressors may become only partially identified. We show that this is not merely an identification problem but creates serious estimation pathologies. Classical estimators, including the maximum score estimator of Manski (1975), not only have population maximizers that are outer regions of the identified set (Komarova (2013)) but also converge to a random set drawn from a finite collection of deterministic regions that partition that outer region. To resolve this failure, we introduce the Random Set Quantile (RSQ) estimator which extracts the τ-quantile of the classical estimator for τ ∈ (1/2, 1). We prove this result for a class of widely used models, which includes binary/multinomial choice and discrete outcome panel data models. This construction is consistent and locally robust across the full parameter space, including precisely those configurations where classical estimators break down. A feasible implementation based on the m-out-of-n bootstrap inherits both properties. We apply the methodology to the 2019 UK General Election, where the discrete support of Brexit-related covariates generates the partial identification our theory analyzes.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了半参数离散选择模型中当协变量离散时经典估计量（如最大得分估计量）会失效的问题，并提出随机集分位数（RSQ）估计量来解决这一估计病态，该估计量一致且局部稳健。
AI.research_question: 当协变量为离散时，半参数离散选择模型中的经典估计量存在怎样的估计病态？如何构建一个一致且局部稳健的替代估计量？
AI.motivation: 离散协变量会导致回归系数从点识别变为部分识别，已有研究关注识别问题但忽视了其导致的严重估计病态——经典估计量的总体最大化子仅为识别集的外区域，且估计量会收敛到从有限个确定性区域中随机抽取的随机集。
AI.theoretical_framework: 半参数离散选择模型、部分识别理论、随机集理论、m-out-of-n Bootstrap
AI.method: 提出随机集分位数（RSQ）估计量，提取经典估计量的τ分位数（τ∈(1/2,1)），并基于m-out-of-n Bootstrap实现可行推断。理论证明覆盖二元/多元选择及离散结果面板数据模型。
AI.findings: RSQ估计量在整个参数空间（包括经典估计量失效的配置）上一致且局部稳健；m-out-of-n Bootstrap的可行实施继承了两者性质。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统揭示离散协变量下经典离散选择估计量的估计病态（而非仅识别病态），提出新的估计量框架解决该问题，并将理论推广至多类模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为涉及离散协变量的实证研究（如2019年英国大选中Brexit相关离散变量）提供了一致且稳健的估计方法。

title: Managing Excess Demand for Primary Care: Evidence from Online Experiments
affiliations: University of Reading, Masaryk University and

detail.title: Managing Excess Demand for Primary Care: Evidence from Online Experiments

declarations.funderStatement: This output was supported by the NPO “Systemic Risk Institute” number LX22NPO5101, funded by European Union - Next Generation EU (Ministry of Education, Youth and Sports, NPO: EXCELES)

detail.abstract: Primary healthcare systems in many developed countries are under strain, partly due to unrestricted patient demand. In response, policymakers have introduced measures to curb unnecessary GP visits, including (i) instituting a small upfront fee for GP visits, (ii) implementing a self-report based triage system, and (iii) providing more information to patients about their condition before they make an appointment with their GP. We evaluate the effectiveness of these approaches using two online experiments with a representative sample of UK adults. The first experiment involves induced monetary incentives in a laboratory-style study while the second is a health-framed vignette study. We find that while all three interventions are effective in the laboratory study, only the intervention that provides patients with more information about their condition reduces low-priority demand in the vignette study. We discuss implications for policy and for the study of health-related decision-making.

AI.tldr: 本文通过两项在线实验（一项实验室式激励实验，一项健康情境实验）评估了三种减少英国不必要的全科医生就诊措施的效果：小额就诊费、自我报告分诊系统和提供更多病情信息。结果发现，在实验室实验中三种措施均有效，但在更真实的情境实验中，只有提供更多信息的措施能降低低优先级就诊需求。
AI.research_question: 哪种政策措施能有效减少不必要的全科医生（GP）就诊需求？
AI.motivation: 发达国家初级医疗系统因患者不受限制的就诊需求而承受压力，需要评估不同政策干预措施的实际效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 健康决策行为理论、激励理论、信息不对称理论
AI.method: 两项在线实验：实验一采用诱导货币激励的实验室式研究；实验二采用健康情境的 vignette 研究。样本为英国成年人的代表性样本。
AI.findings: 实验室实验中三种干预措施（小额费用、自我报告分诊、提供信息）均有效；但在情境实验中，只有提供更多病情信息的干预措施显著减少了低优先级就诊需求。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了不同实验设计（激励性质 vs 情境模拟）对健康政策干预效果评估的差异，强调了外部效度的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于减少不必要GP就诊的循证建议，指出提供患者病情信息可能是最稳健有效的干预手段。

title: Huestoc Theory and The Limits of  Collective Brain Models - A framework of Heuristic Generation and Stochastic Selection
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Huestoc Theory and The Limits of  Collective Brain Models - A framework of Heuristic Generation and Stochastic Selection

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Independent researcher. Returning to academics after a break
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable
declarations.funderStatement: entirely self funded out of my earning and saving

detail.abstract:
Paper 1 demonstrated that Collective Brain models fail to explain the origin of paradigm-shifting novelty from 500 BCE to 2026 CE.

This paper surveys the entire landscape those models cannot map, and proposes Heustoc Theory as the unifying successor framework. Heustoc combines two mechanisms:

(a) Heuristic Generation, the directional production of novelty through practical insight, rule-of-thumb reasoning, or guided search; and…

(b) Stochastic selection/Filtering, the survival or rejection of those novelties through contingency, repetition, institutional pressure, power, adoption, and historical timing.

We pre-empt the objection that unified theories overreach by deriving boundary conditions from real-time diffusion data. Real-time saturation dynamics from Paper 1 (n=475, D/V=89.9%, d²D/dt²<0 as of 22-May-26 23:20 IST) validate the model before peer review.

Using comparative historical analysis across scientific discovery, invention, language, ritual, faith, conquest, peer-review failure, flat-Earth persistence, and AI generation, we show that collective systems amplify, stabilize, or suppress novelty, but do not explain how it first appears or why it survives.

Heustoc is proposed as a compact and general explanatory framework for the emergence and retention of new forms across history and technology.

AI.tldr: 本文批判了集体大脑模型在解释范式性创新起源上的不足，提出了赫斯托克理论（Heustoc Theory）作为统一替代框架，通过启发式生成与随机选择/过滤两大机制，解释了从公元前500年到2026年期间新颖性的产生与存续。
AI.research_question: 集体大脑模型为何无法解释范式转换性新颖性的起源？赫斯托克理论能否作为统一的替代解释框架？
AI.motivation: 集体大脑模型无法解释从公元前500年到2026年期间范式转换性新颖性的起源，现有理论存在解释盲区，需要更紧凑、更通用的理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 赫斯托克理论（Heustoc Theory），包含两个核心机制：（a）启发式生成——通过实践洞察、经验法则或引导性搜索来定向产生新颖性；（b）随机选择/过滤——新颖性通过偶然性、重复、制度压力、权力、采纳和历史时机而存续或消亡。
AI.method: 比较历史分析法，涵盖科学发现、发明、语言、仪式、信仰、征服、同行评审失败、地平说持续存在和人工智能生成等多个领域；辅以实时传播数据饱和动力学验证（n=475, D/V=89.9%, d²D/dt²<0）。
AI.findings: 集体系统可以放大、稳定或压制新颖性，但无法解释新颖性最初如何出现以及为何存续；赫斯托克理论能够解释新颖性从出现到存续的全过程。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出赫斯托克理论作为统一解释框架，填补了集体大脑模型无法解释新颖性起源的理论空白；通过实时数据预判潜在批评，增强了理论的边界条件严谨性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解历史、技术与文化中的创新起源与传播提供了可操作的分析框架；对人工智能生成、制度设计、创新管理等实践领域具有指导意义。

title: How the New Substitution Rule Affected Bundesliga Results
affiliations: Helmut-Schmidt-University Hamburg, Helmut-Schmidt-University Hamburg and Helmut-Schmidt-University Hamburg

detail.title: How the New Substitution Rule Affected Bundesliga Results
detail.abstract: This study empirically analyzes the influence of the so-called five-substitution rule on the results of the German Bundesliga. The rule, which was first introduced for the 2019/20 season as a temporary solution to the strains of the Covid-19 pandemic, was permanently incorporated into the regulations starting from the season 2022/23. While the primary goal of the rule change was to relieve the burden on players, it may also have an impact on match outcomes and dynamics. We show that while the total number of goals has increased, the probability of match outcomes remained constant. One could therefore conclude that the rule change has at least increased the entertainment value of the matches.

AI.tldr: 本研究实证分析了德甲联赛“五次换人规则”的影响，发现该规则增加了总进球数，但未改变比赛结果的概率分布，从而提升了比赛的娱乐价值。
AI.research_question: 五次换人规则如何影响德甲联赛的比赛结果和比赛动态？
AI.motivation: 五次换人规则最初作为新冠疫情下的临时措施引入，后永久纳入规则。虽然主要目的是减轻球员负担，但该规则也可能对比赛结果和动态产生影响，值得实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于规则变化对比赛产出（进球数、结果概率）影响的分析框架。
AI.method: 实证分析，对比规则引入前后德甲联赛的比赛数据。
AI.findings: 五次换人规则实施后，比赛总进球数有所增加，但比赛结果的概率分布（胜平负概率）保持不变。
AI.theory_contributions: 为足球规则变化对比赛产出影响的研究提供了新的实证证据，揭示了规则调整在保持结果公平性的同时可提升比赛观赏性的机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为足球联赛管理者提供了规则调整效果的实证依据：五次换人规则在不改变比赛结果公平性的前提下，提升了比赛的娱乐价值，支持了该规则的永久保留。

title: Constitutional Mathematics for Pharmaceutical Reproducibility: A Machine-Verifiable Standard

detail.title: Constitutional Mathematics for Pharmaceutical Reproducibility: A Machine-Verifiable Standard

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the Principal Architect of the R3/CSD framework and holds a pending patent (US 19/383,582). The author declares no competing financial interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This research develops a formal mathematical framework for pharmaceutical reproducibility and does not involve human subjects, clinical trials, or biological samples.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding or financial support from any public, commercial, or not-for-profit entity. The research was independently conceived and developed by the author as part of the Universal Standard Axiom Corporation’s initiative to establish a formal standard for machine-verifiable regulatory compliance.
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: Not applicable. This paper presents a theoretical framework for standardizing data provenance in pharmaceutical manufacturing, not the results of a clinical trial.

keywords: de facto standard JEL Classification: I10

detail.abstract: The pharmaceutical and biomedical industries face a systemic replication crisis rooted in fragmented, unstandardized data provenance and the absence of machine-verifiable purity standards. This paper establishes a formal de facto standard for pharmaceutical System (BCS), ISO/IEC 17025, and IEEE 2418 blockchain interoperability requirements. Thirteen baseline pharmaceutical targets across four therapeutic regimes are mapped to the constitutional basis, demonstrating utility across small molecule enzyme inhibitors, biologic monoclonal antibodies, nucleic acid therapeutics, and prodrug systems.

AI.tldr: 本文针对制药和生物医学领域数据溯源碎片化、缺乏标准化纯度标准导致的系统性可重复性危机，建立了融合USP-NF药典标准、BCS分类系统、ISO/IEC 17025及IEEE 2418区块链互操作性要求的正式事实标准。通过将13个跨四种治疗模式的基线药物靶点映射到宪法基础，证明了该标准在小分子酶抑制剂、生物单克隆抗体、核酸治疗药物和前药系统中的实用性。
AI.research_question: 如何建立一套融合药典标准、质量控制体系和区块链互操作性要求的形式化事实标准，以解决制药和生物医学领域因数据溯源碎片化和缺乏机器可验证纯度标准导致的系统性可重复性危机？
AI.motivation: 制药和生物医学行业面临系统性的可重复性危机，其根源在于数据溯源碎片化、非标准化，以及缺乏机器可验证的纯度标准，亟需建立统一的形式化标准来解决这一问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于USP-NF药典标准、BCS分类系统、ISO/IEC 17025实验室质量管理体系以及IEEE 2418区块链互操作性要求等多重标准框架，构建形式化事实标准。
AI.method: 将13个基线药物靶点（涵盖小分子酶抑制剂、生物单克隆抗体、核酸治疗药物和前药系统四种治疗模式）映射到所建立的宪法基础（标准框架）上，验证标准的实用性。
AI.findings: 该形式化事实标准在小分子酶抑制剂、生物单克隆抗体、核酸治疗药物和前药系统四种治疗模式中均展现了实用性，证明了其跨治疗模式的通用性和有效性。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将USP-NF、BCS、ISO/IEC 17025和IEEE 2418区块链标准整合为统一的形式化事实标准框架，为制药数据可追溯性和纯度验证提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为制药和生物医学行业提供了可操作的标准化方案，有助于解决数据溯源碎片化问题，提升研究的可重复性，并通过区块链技术确保数据的机器可验证性和安全性。

detail.title: The Retreat of Federal Power and the Rise of Post-Supremacy Federalism

publicationDetails.detailsText: Victoria Grace Litman, The Retreat of Federal Power and the Rise of Post-Supremacy Federalism, 74 Clev. St. L. Rev. 651 (2026) available at https://engagedscholarship.csuohio.edu/clevstlrev/vol74/iss3/7

detail.abstract:
This Article introduces the theory of post-supremacy federalism to describe a structural condition in which federal law remains formally binding, but enforcement has durably receded or collapsed. Unlike frameworks grounded in intergovernmental friction or negotiated cooperation, this account begins from federal retreat—the cumulative erosion of enforcement capacity across judicial, administrative, legislative, and executive institutions. Post-supremacy federalism arises when three conditions are met: (1) federal law remains intact; (2) enforcement retreats; and (3) no formal devolution occurs. In this vacuum, states are not merely filling gaps. They are governing by default—under laws that still bind but no longer structure governance in a coherent or consistent way.

This Article maps the institutional dynamics behind this transformation, including judicial realignment, administrative collapse, legislative paralysis, and the rise of executive unilateralism. It then traces how this retreat manifests in four domains: drug policy, public education, environmental protection, and reproductive healthcare. In each, federal authority persists in theory, but meaningful enforcement has eroded—leaving states to construct and implement their own legal regimes without delegation, partnership, or protection. These domains are not newly decentralized. They are abandoned. Statutes like the Controlled Substances Act, Title IX, the Clean Air Act, and EMTALA remain binding, yet no longer coordinate or constrain state action. In their place, states exercise contingent authority—governing under conditions of legal precarity and enforcement asymmetry, exposed to federal snapback and forced to navigate an unstable landscape.

This Article does not propose reform. It offers a diagnosis. Post-supremacy federalism names the legal condition that emerges when federal authority recedes but does not relinquish control. Naming that condition is the first step toward understanding how governance now unfolds—and what may come next.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"后至上联邦制"理论，描述联邦法律形式上仍具约束力但执法能力已持久衰退的结构性状况。当（1）联邦法律仍有效；（2）执法退缩；（3）未发生正式权力下放三个条件满足时，后至上联邦制便形成。各州在此法律真空中并非填补空白，而是"默认治理"——在法律仍具约束力但已无法协调或约束州行动的情况下运行。文章从毒品政策、公共教育、环境保护和生殖健康四个领域剖析了这一现象。
AI.research_question: 当联邦法律仍具形式约束力但执法能力已持久衰退时，联邦与州之间的治理结构会发生怎样的根本性转变？
AI.motivation: 现有联邦制理论多基于府际摩擦或协商合作，忽视了联邦执法衰退这一重要维度。本文旨在为"联邦撤退但未放弃控制"这一被忽视的治理现象提供一个系统性理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 后至上联邦制（Post-Supremacy Federalism）理论，区别于传统的府际关系理论和合作联邦制理论。
AI.method: 理论建构与跨领域案例分析，涵盖毒品政策（受控物质法）、公共教育（第九条）、环境保护（清洁空气法）和生殖健康（EMTALA）四个政策领域。
AI.findings: 后至上联邦制的形成源于司法重组、行政崩溃、立法瘫痪和行政单边主义等制度动力。在四个分析领域中，联邦法律虽仍具约束力，但执法已严重侵蚀，各州在无授权、无合作、无保护的情况下自行构建法律体系，处于法律不确定性和执法不对称的状态，面临联邦"回缩"的风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"后至上联邦制"这一新概念，填补了联邦制理论中关于"联邦形式权威与实质执法能力脱节"的理论空白；区分了"权力下放"与"被抛弃"的根本差异；为理解当代联邦治理提供了新的分析范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和法律实践者诊断当前联邦制运行中的结构性危机提供了概念工具；揭示了州层面"或有权威"的法律不稳定性及其治理风险；为预判联邦执法能力恢复或进一步衰退的后果提供了分析基础。

title: The Impact of Financial Crisis on the Rate of Parathyroidectomy in Lebanese Hemodialysis Patients: A Single-Centre Study

detail.title: The Impact of Financial Crisis on the Rate of Parathyroidectomy in Lebanese Hemodialysis Patients: A Single-Centre Study

declarations.declarationOfInterest: All authors declare no conflicts of interest relevant to this work.
